President Donald Trump fired the chairman of the Joint Chiefs of
Staff, Air Force Gen. C.Q. Brown, and a number of other top military
officers in a dramatic shakeup of Pentagon leadership. Trump
campaigned heavily on the idea of removing "woke" generals from the
top of the military. Trump’s defense secretary, Pete Hegseth, has
also made it a point to root out Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
(DEI) initiatives in the military.

| | | | | We’re back with a [can’t-miss episode of the No Doubt About It Podcast](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=3524c27d8f&e=567664f14c), breaking down the latest insanity in government spending, Trump’s face-off with Zelensky, and the biggest challenge Trump must fix now if he wants to secure victory.
---
[](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=561378bed1&e=567664f14c)
|
# What You’ll Hear in This Episode:
---
| **New Mexico’s Budget Insanity:** The state budget is bigger than ever with record surpluses, yet lawmakers are trying to raise energy taxes by $450 million. Meanwhile, they just allocated **$3.5 million for... beavers?!** Yes, you read that right. With all this extra money, why aren’t they helping working families instead of funding the world’s largest rodent? Mark breaks down how legislators continue to prioritize government control and crushing regulations instead of supporting small businesses.
**Trump vs. Zelensky in the Oval Office:**
The Trump-Zelensky face-off was pure theater, and we make the case that there’s only one real path to peace. Krysty explains why Zelensky’s failure to use an interpreter hurt his message—and how it could impact the war effort. Meanwhile, polling shows the American people overwhelmingly agree with Trump’s position.
---

---
| **Trump’s Biggest Problem on the Horizon:**
The Economy With looming tariffs and massive debt refinancing, Trump’s upcoming address to Congress on Tuesday is a must-watch moment. We warn that if anything is going to be a major issue for Trump in 2025, it’s the economy—and he better get ahead of it now.
**The Girl Scout Cookie Showdown:**
A doctor confronted Girl Scouts, offering to buy all their cookies—just to throw them away! We react to whether this guy is a health-conscious hero or just a massive buzzkill.

Donald Trump is just a few hours away from delivering the first joint address to Congress of his second term. While I don’t yet know the specifics of his remarks, here’s one thing I know for sure about this evening: I’m honored to be joined by Liz Crandall, a former United States Forest Service Ranger from Bend, Oregon.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/103239350/531594986/476240477?amount=10&refcode=em_fr_2025.03.04_b1_jb_all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY3MjEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOGFmMTE5MzQtNTVmOS1lZjExLTkwY2QtMDAyMjQ4MmE5ZmI3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=OPTIWpvuc1aAEU2nKTdSQUgkNDDV8lnh9uH6rYnGv2g=)
Donald Trump is just a few hours away from delivering the first joint address to Congress of his second term. While I don’t yet know the specifics of his remarks, here’s one thing I know for sure about this evening:

**I’m honored to be joined by Liz Crandall, a former United States Forest Service Ranger from Bend, Oregon.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/103239351/531594987/476240477?amount=10&refcode=em_fr_2025.03.04_b1_jb_all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY3MjEiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOGFmMTE5MzQtNTVmOS1lZjExLTkwY2QtMDAyMjQ4MmE5ZmI3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=OPTIWpvuc1aAEU2nKTdSQUgkNDDV8lnh9uH6rYnGv2g=)
Liz is a public servant through and through. From extinguishing abandoned campfires to keeping park visitors away from dangerous areas, Liz and her fellow rangers keep our communities safe from the threat of catastrophic wildfires.

**But last month, Liz was fired by DOGE.** She was one of at least 16 Deschutes National Forest employees to be fired by Elon Musk in the DOGE rampages.

Not only was this decision cruel, but it’s just foolish. Firing US Forest Service Rangers, especially in the wake of devastating wildfires across the country, is only going to make our communities more vulnerable to these disasters.

Listen, when I ran for Congress, I vowed to work across the aisle and partner with anyone to lower costs, create jobs, and improve the day-to-day for Oregonians. I stand by that.

| | Every year, I hold a town hall in each of Oregon's 36 counties. I'm proud to have hosted over 1,100 open-to-all town halls during my time in the Senate. **Hearing from and being accountable to the people who elected you is an essential part of being an elected official.** Over the last few weeks, there have been news reports of Republicans holding town halls that result in the inevitable: angry constituents scared about the lawless actions of the Trump-Musk administration threatening their family and way of life. Instead of listening to these concerns and taking their constituents seriously, Republicans are doubling down, and have even declared they will stop hosting in-person town halls. I was encouraged by the recent news of Republicans being forced to justify their extreme agenda to their constituents, but now they're running scared, too afraid to face their own voters. Republicans are hoping they can get away with ramming their dangerous and radical agenda through Congress without anyone noticing. Well rest assured, people are taking note, and I will not let them go quietly. I will continue making as much noise as I can about how the Trump-Musk administration is making Americans less safe. **Republicans are on defense** trying to explain why they've ceded Congress' power of the purse and oversight authority while an unelected billionaire raids through personal data, slashes critical services, and fires thousands of hardworking people. Slowly but surely, we are seeing more and more communities take it upon themselves to stand up for our democracy – and remind Republicans what democracy looks like. I will keep holding town halls because I believe that nothing is more important or powerful than **constituents telling their representatives what should be done.** And I encourage everyone – no matter what state or district you're in – to attend town halls if you can. subject: Remember Inflation? I DO.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Seth Moulton for Congress
body:
Fellow Democrat:

Remember inflation? It was supposedly the central focus of Donald Trump and MAGA Republicans, who promised ON DAY ONE that inflation would all but go away.

But ON DAY ONE, they pardoned January 6th terrorists and since then it’s been a carnival for ketamine-using billionaires and special interests, renaming bodies of water, seeking vengeance against the FBI and starting trade wars that are only going to make things worse.

I’m Gay Valimont, the Democratic nominee for Florida’s First Congressional Seat that’s vacant because Matt Gaetz took a very public dive. While HE went down, inflation hasn’t. That’s why I need your help.

We have a special election on April 1st - less than 30 days away - and if we flip this seat and two other special election seats up for the vote - Democrats could RETAKE THE HOUSE in 2025 - and start making laws to LOWER inflation.

Can you help my campaign for working families by splitting a contribution between my campaign and Seth Moulton. Can you do $5? Or $15? Or $30? Or MORE? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/m26-valimont]

Donate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/m26-valimont]In my race to replace Matt Gaetz, I’ve outlined several steps I’d take to help Floridians in the Panhandle: RAISE THE WAGE FOR ENLISTED FAMILIES. Protect the Affordable Care Act to keep costs low. Expand supports for child care and home healthcare. AND NO to stupid trade wars.

I know what it’s like to struggle with medical bills - and to make ends meet. I’ve heard the voices all over the 1st District: They gave Trump and MAGA Republicans a chance, thinking - HOPING - that they’d really do what they said and focus on the economy.

That’s why I need your help to deliver a real VICTORY for Democrats on April 1. Can I count on you to split a donation between my campaign and Seth Moulton right now to DEFEAT MAGA Extremism? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/m26-valimont]

Gay Valimont

Democratic Nominee (FL-01)

body:
Friend, I wanted to follow up with you.
---
Since I last reached out, Donald Trump, Elon Musk, and their allies in Congress have further proven that they're not working for you and your family.

From shuttering the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau to proposing draconian cuts to Medicaid, _every day_ they show that they're more worried about helping themselves and their wealthy friends get richer and richer – while you pay the price.
That's why I'm doing everything in my power to hold the line against Trump's reckless agenda and push back against his extreme nominees.
**But, friend, as I fight with everything I have to stop this administration's most destructive actions, I need to know where you stand. So please, could you take just a minute or two to share your thoughts in my latest survey?**
**Here's a link just for you:**[**http://surveys.signforgood.com/warnock-q1-2025-priorities?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/103239964/531608971/375045551?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100&code=jtk5477-su-nd&refcode=jtk5477-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMTUzMDBmYy01OGY5LWVmMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UrpeuKoPQCKxjWHW1W5eQed5X1GSHh4K2g6zhMdd9w0=&emci=678fc575-25f6-ef11-90cb-0022482a93b5&emdi=e15300fc-58f9-ef11-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=1586379)
Thank you for providing your input. I'm grateful to have you with me in this fight for the future of our country.

– Rev. Raphael Warnock

Subject: In this moment of uncertainty, I want to share my steadfast promise with you:
| | |
---
Friend,

I know that the past few weeks have been filled with a lot of chaos, confusion, and policies from the Trump administration that directly harm the American people.
That's why, in this time of great uncertainty, I wanted to reach out and personally share my steadfast promise with you: **I will always prioritize making life better for _you_ and _your_ family – not billionaires and the wealthy few. **
That means lowering the costs of prescription drugs so no one has to choose between food and medicine. It means bringing down _everyday_ costs and making it easier for families to make ends meet. It means fighting with everything I have to protect our most fundamental freedoms. And it means staying ready to hold the line against all of the dangerous actions that are undoubtedly still to come from this administration.
**But I know that there is no shortage of issues that folks are focused on right now, friend. That's why it's so important for me to hear from you directly about _your_ top priorities and concerns: ****[Will you please take just a minute or two to share your thoughts with me in a brand-new priorities survey? Hearing what's top of mind for you right now is essential to guiding my work in the Senate.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/103239965/531608973/375045551?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100&code=jtk5477-su-nd&refcode=jtk5477-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTEvMS85MDkwMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlMTUzMDBmYy01OGY5LWVmMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UrpeuKoPQCKxjWHW1W5eQed5X1GSHh4K2g6zhMdd9w0=&emci=678fc575-25f6-ef11-90cb-0022482a93b5&emdi=e15300fc-58f9-ef11-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=1586379)**

body:
A letter asking for you to fight for our values against enemies of democracy

| | [ ](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=JgyyvCfQwldlSeD7KJl_Ih7269o_4hwqOhPs1_PHvgI&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ukraine_nato_email&n=1)
---
| Peter -- The past week has been unbelievably troubling for anyone who believes in democracy and American leadership. We need to let our leaders know that we have their backs if they stand up against this Administration moving closer to autocrats and away from our democratic allies. If you feel as strongly as we do about this, please sign our letter [here](https://home.forwardparty.com/ukraine_nato_support?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ukraine_nato_email&n=2).
An excerpt:
_Aligning with Russia, which disrupted this peace by invading Ukraine, undermines the stability, peace, and prosperity that Americans have fought and died to preserve. Russia's system of government and values are inherently contrary to America's, and the Russian leadership has shown itself to be untrustworthy and interested in self-enrichment rather than any type of shared prosperity._
Again, [please add your name to ours](https://home.forwardparty.com/ukraine_nato_support?e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ukraine_nato_email&n=3) as we let our elected officials know that this is not the right direction for America.

Let’s talk about Trump’s meeting with Ukrainian President Zelenskyy. Trump’s outburst in the Oval Office last week was more than just a temper tantrum — it’s a clear demonstration of what motivates this president: a fixation on power and dominance. Trump and his allies appear to be under the impression that to be a strong leader, everyone else needs to shut up and fall in line. That’s why he fawns over dictators like Vladimir Putin and Kim Jong Un. It’s why he obsesses over crowd sizes and calls opponents names like “Little Marco.” This is more than your typical machismo or toxic masculinity. It’s a deeply ingrained obsession with power and superiority and it impacts more than international diplomacy. Take climate policy for example. Instead of seeking real energy independence, Trump recently established a “National Energy Dominance Council” by executive order. Instead of addressing the climate crisis, we get a reckless, chest-thumping excuse to keep fossil fuel companies in control and our planet on fire. If the people in power are motivated by domination instead of decency, the road to peace, prosperity, and climate action will always hit a dead end. **That’s why at the Jane Fonda Climate PAC, we take immense pride in fighting to elect leaders with diverse backgrounds, life experiences, and — above all — a desire to serve the people, not control them.** Take Rep. Maxwell Frost — Gen Z’s first member of Congress, who is bringing fresh ideas and a deep commitment to climate justice. Or Texas State Senator Molly Cook, a bold progressive and the first openly LGBTQ+ member to serve in the Texas Senate. Or Nebraska State Senator Ashlei Spivey, who just made history as the first Black woman to serve in her chamber in nearly a decade. These are the leaders we need. Empathetic. Bold. Unafraid. And servants for the people — not their own egos. We’re electing them at every level of government. **Last year, we helped elect more than 100 climate champions in high-stakes races** — from Colorado county commissioners to Portland city council members to state legislators across the country. Each one is a piece of the firewall we’re building against Trump’s reckless agenda. **[But the work isn’t done. The stakes are only getting higher. And to keep electing leaders who lead with empathy, we need your help. clean_body: Real strength comes from diversity. | Let’s talk about Trump’s meeting with Ukrainian President Zelenskyy. Trump’s outburst in the Oval Office last week was more than just a temper tantrum — it’s a clear demonstration of what motivates this president: a fixation on power and dominance. Trump and his allies appear to be under the impression that to be a strong leader, everyone else needs to shut up and fall in line. That’s why he fawns over dictators like Vladimir Putin and Kim Jong Un. It’s why he obsesses over crowd sizes and calls opponents names like “Little Marco.” This is more than your typical machismo or toxic masculinity. It’s a deeply ingrained obsession with power and superiority and it impacts more than international diplomacy. Take climate policy for example. Instead of seeking real energy independence, Trump recently established a “National Energy Dominance Council” by executive order. Instead of addressing the climate crisis, we get a reckless, chest-thumping excuse to keep fossil fuel companies in control and our planet on fire. If the people in power are motivated by domination instead of decency, the road to peace, prosperity, and climate action will always hit a dead end. That’s why at the Jane Fonda Climate PAC, we take immense pride in fighting to elect leaders with diverse backgrounds, life experiences, and — above all — a desire to serve the people, not control them. Take Rep. Maxwell Frost — Gen Z’s first member of Congress, who is bringing fresh ideas and a deep commitment to climate justice. Or Texas State Senator Molly Cook, a bold progressive and the first openly LGBTQ+ member to serve in the Texas Senate. Or Nebraska State Senator Ashlei Spivey, who just made history as the first Black woman to serve in her chamber in nearly a decade. These are the leaders we need. Empathetic. Bold. Unafraid. And servants for the people — not their own egos. We’re electing them at every level of government. This is our moment to GUT the managerial bureaucracy, FIRE anyone connected to the weaponization of our own government against us, SLASH the size and scope of the administrative state, and usher in the GOLDEN AGE for America!

But the Deep State is already putting up the fight of its life. They're resisting change at every turn. Make no mistake - we can't afford to squander this historic opportunity. That's why President Trump needs trusted partnerships at the state level RIGHT NOW!

---

This one's easy. I was born and raised here in the Buckeye State and graduated from St. Xavier - a Catholic high school in Cincinnati. My wife, Apporva, and I live outside Columbus, raising our two boys here. I've started multiple businesses in Ohio. I've also known JD Vance since college and campaigned all over the state for our excellent new Senator, Bernie Moreno.

Derek,
First, Elon Musk and Donald Trump slashed thousands of Social Security employees, with some reports that up to 50% of the agency will be cut, putting benefits for tens of millions of Americans at risk.
Then, Elon Musk went on a podcast and called Social Security “the biggest Ponzi Scheme of all time,” reminding us of what we’ve known all along: the Trump administration doesn’t care about workers making ends meet (or, you know, real facts) as long as their billionaire buddies get their tax breaks.
What a load of BS. Social Security is a promise that our government makes to workers, who pay into the program. (Remember: Social Security adds $0 to the deficit!)
Given Trump’s history of stiffing people who worked for him, it’s not surprising that he now wants to break our government’s promise to workers. But when he and his allies threaten something so disgusting, we have to speak up.

** WHY RUN NOW? **
---
President Trump winning re-election in November was not just another political victory - it was a seismic realignment for our country. He won every swing state. He improved his vote share of minorities and young voters. We won the House AND Senate. And heck, he even won the popular vote.

This is our moment to GUT the managerial bureaucracy, FIRE anyone connected to the weaponization of our own government against us, SLASH the size and scope of the administrative state, and usher in the GOLDEN AGE for America!

But the Deep State is already putting up the fight of its life. They're resisting change at every turn. Make no mistake - we can't afford to squander this historic opportunity. That's why President Trump needs trusted partnerships at the state level RIGHT NOW!

---
** WHY OHIO? **
---
This one's easy. I was born and raised here in the Buckeye State and graduated from St. Xavier - a Catholic high school in Cincinnati. My wife, Apporva, and I live outside Columbus, raising our two boys here. I've started multiple businesses in Ohio. I've also known JD Vance since college and campaigned all over the state for our excellent new Senator, Bernie Moreno.

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football’s 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville’s time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year’s Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP’s SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul “Bear” Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for re-election so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in the United States Senate. The Radical Left has him circled as a prime target to defeat in the 2026 Midterm Elections. Can he count on your support? _

| Tonight, President Trump delivered a joint address to Congress outlining his agenda and his progress so far this term. It was a sobering reminder of why I decided to run for Congress to represent West Michigan.

Over the past few weeks, we’ve witnessed an administration more invested in dismantling our democracy and enriching themselves than helping the American people, as well as a House Republican majority emboldened to follow its lead. West Michigan families deserve leaders who put their country before their party; it’s why I decided to run for Congress.

**In 2022, I became the first pro-choice woman elected to serve West Michigan and the first Democrat in 50 years to flip this Republican stronghold._This wasn’t just a win; it was a declaration._

That’s why I’m doing everything I can to fight back and win a majority that prioritizes their constituents, not unelected billionaires. MI-03 continues to be at the center of that battle. | | Team,

I just finished my address to the nation! This is a message of confidence, strength, and hope.

**TOGETHER, WE ARE RENEWING THE AMERICAN DREAM.**

I have accomplished more in one month than any President in four years!

**#1** Closed the Border and ENDED THE INVASION
**#2** Built a Strong Economy and created great American Jobs
**#3** Unleashed Maximum Pressure thanks to the historic Trump Tariffs

**#4** Cut billions in Waste, Fraud, and Abuse thanks to my new and bold Department of Government Efficiency
**#5** Secured Hundreds of Billions in Investments from American and International Business to bring back manufacturing to the USA
**#6** Ended DEI
**#7** Unveiled the Gulf of America
**#8** Protected Women’s sports
**#9** America is respected again. PEACE THROUGH STRENGTH.
**#10** _WE MADE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN!_

subject: Tonight’s address:
body:
Deceive, distract, divide.
---
Derek, If you watched Trump’s address to Congress and were disturbed by what you heard, then we’re asking you to make a donation to the DNC tonight. Not tomorrow or next week, but **tonight**. Here’s why: Everything Trump says is intended to do at least one of these three things: Deceive, distract, divide. **And that strategy was on full display again during Trump’s address.** Derek, Trump would love nothing more than for his lies to go unchecked while we’re all too distracted by the daily chaos of his administration. He’d love to see all of us turn on each other so we’re not paying attention as he consolidates power for himself and gives a giant tax cut to his billionaire allies. We can’t afford to let that happen. [**That’s why tonight, we hope you’ll become a founding donor to our new Stop the Lies Fund. Every gift will help the DNC build out our war room, organize everywhere, and elect more Democrats who will resist Trump’s agenda:](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-march-2025-stop-the-lies-fund?amount=3&refcode=em_20250304_2889_fr&refcode2=2889_22930333_hqhXKn&akid=2889%2E22930333%2EhqhXKn) _If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly._ | | | **[Donate $3](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-march-2025-stop-the-lies-fund?express_lane=true&amount=3&refcode=em_20250304_2889_fr&refcode2=2889_22930333_hqhXKn&akid=2889%2E22930333%2EhqhXKn)**

body:
I just finished giving the official response to Trump’s speech. I hope you had a chance to watch. If not, I'll share a link with you tomorrow.
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2250%2E135344%2EtY_5hs)

Hi everyone.
I just finished giving the official response to President Trump’s Joint Address. I hope you had a chance to watch. If not, I'll share a link with you tomorrow.
Since most people don't know me like you do, I introduced myself and just kept it straight with the people watching about the moment we are in right now.
We just went through another fraught election season. Americans made it clear that they want change. But there is a responsible way to make change, and a reckless way. And, we can make that change without forgetting who we are as a country, and as a democracy.
Because no matter where you live, most Americans share three core beliefs: That the middle class is the engine of our country. That strong national security protects us from harm. And that our democracy, no matter how messy, is unparalleled and worth fighting for.
We all know that our country is going through something right now. We’re not sure what the next day is going to hold, let alone the next decade.
But this isn’t the first time we’ve experienced this as a country. Every single time, we’ve gotten through those moments because of two things: Engaged citizens and principled leaders.
Every day I will fight to be the kind of principled leader the people who elected me deserve, and it's a message I hope to carry with me as I campaign for others next fall.
If you're with me in that fight, I have an ask of you:
[**Can you make a small contribution - $5, $50 or whatever you can afford - to help me elect a new generation of leaders who put country first?**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-mar25.ecmY5i&refcode=em250304-2&t=2&akid=2250%2E135344%2EtY_5hs)

| Dear Peter:

There are times when the toilet is just too full. That was tonight's Joint Address to Congress. Flush. Flush.

I was not interested in attending tonight's Joint Address, but I did want to bring a guest and I wanted the person to bring meaning and visibility to the thousands of workers who have been unlawfully terminated by Trump and Musk.

I invited Ms. Sylvia Joyner. She is an AFGE worker who has worked for USAID for 34 years. She now advocates for those who have and are being fired. Ms. Sylvia could only attend if I was in attendance. She deserved to have Trump see her. She deserved to have a voice tonight.

[I also knew I was going to walk out because the lies would be too much and the American people deserve more than they are getting from General Bone Spurs. I was right.](https://kamlagerforassembly.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7fbfb0a1bdf4e44789fab92d0&id=51386eb2f2&e=e6ba7d1bc4)

name: Victor Riches
subject: Every second counts to save Elijah’s life
body:
At age 6, Elijah Stacy was diagnosed with a fatal and incurable disease.

|
---
| | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z5nf5r8bvon0o7tf1phf40r3a4hnhj1iein19un0_rp22sh2s8i6eob4chjm4ob0s1h2bs)
Friend,

_At age 6, Elijah Stacy was diagnosed with a fatal and incurable disease.
By age 11, Elijah lost his ability to walk.
Now, at age 23, Elijah is fighting for his life._

Elijah suffers from a rare genetic disease called Duchenne muscular dystrophy.

As a progressive muscle-wasting disease, Duchenne muscular dystrophy patients lose the ability to walk before age 12, lose arm functionality as a teenager, and face a tragically short lifespan, often passing away in their mid-twenties.

Elijah is fighting two important battles. Not only is he fighting for a cure, but he is also fighting against government bureaucrats standing in the way of his medical freedom. That’s why he supports Goldwater’s _Right to Try for Individualized Treatments_ — a new law that allows patients to access cutting-edge therapies based on their genetics.
_**“I support anything that gives people medical freedom. I support anything that allows us to accelerate.” - Elijah Stacy**_
I’m Victor Riches, President and CEO of the Goldwater Institute. At the Goldwater Institute, we know that people should be free to make their own decisions about their health and life.

The Right to Try for Individualized Treatments is a landmark reform that creates a pathway for Americans to access innovative, individualized treatments that have not yet received approval from the Food and Drug Administration.

**Although it has been enacted in six states, the Goldwater Institute is fighting to expand this legislation to every state.**

[The Goldwater Institute has a goal of $50,000 to pass the Right to Try for Individualized Treatments nationwide. Could you chip in $35, $50, $100, or even $10 to help give terminally ill patients the medical freedom they deserve?](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zsbfh78girghik87gg0fiqrvmko8islddrrdghu0_rp22sh2s8i6eob4chjm4ob0s1h2bs)
[Donate Now](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zenuvin22511md4oe8drdh980tm89jra41qpb9kg_rp22sh2s8i6eob4chjm4ob0s1h2bs)
I don’t say this often with our policy proposals, but it’s true... the Right to Try for Individualized Treatments is saving lives, and it is an issue beyond partisanship.

The Goldwater Institute believes that personal health decisions should be made between patients and doctors, not bureaucrats in Washington, D.C.

By passing the Right to Try for Individualized Treatments, terminally ill patients have the opportunity to access potentially life-saving treatments. We are giving hope to many who feel the system is against them.

[Will you help us fight for the Right to Try for Individualized Treatments? Click here to show your support for medical freedom for terminally ill patients.>>>](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zisk8bfiipvoh6fg53k3bq4qte2q4m07gisonfp8_rp22sh2s8i6eob4chjm4ob0s1h2bs)

The Goldwater Institute will never back down in the battle for medical freedom.

Patients and their families should be free to make decisions that are best for them without first asking the government for permission.

**In Elijah’s words,_“If the patient wants it, if the company's willing to give it, and most importantly, in my opinion, the physician agrees with it, it's something that makes sense.”_**

[Please help the Goldwater Institute reach our $50,000 goal to defend medical freedom. Please donate today by clicking any button below.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zrh2dc70cirhm0q18rtb44qcp3fh45ho4kcqjkag_rp22sh2s8i6eob4chjm4ob0s1h2bs)

| | Dear Friend,

Learning about how early Christians worshipped and prayed, faced persecution and hardship, and settled theological disputes enriches our understanding of the faith. These lessons are especially important today, as Christians face increasing opposition from the culture.

But, beyond reading the New Testament and some of the stories of early Christian martyrs, it can be daunting to figure out how to proceed. The complicated history of imperial Rome, along with the foreign names and locations featured in early Christian history, can make understanding the most important historical points difficult.

To uncover this fascinating history, we've produced our online course, "[Ancient Christianity](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhg9t6ampnsv9gdvbtcr5p3nhtalng2g6qhcnrlo_rp22sh2s8i6eob4chjm4ob1cph2bs)," now available on DVD.

In this course, Professor Kenneth Calvert is your guide through the first four centuries of Christianity as he explains the remarkable ways the new faith transformed the Roman world.

Would you help support this course so we can make it available to millions of Americans for free? As a token of our appreciation for your support, we'll send you a copy of our beautiful DVD Box Set for any donations of $100 or more.

body:

---
| | Dear Friend,

Learning about how early Christians worshipped and prayed, faced persecution and hardship, and settled theological disputes enriches our understanding of the faith. These lessons are especially important today, as Christians face increasing opposition from the culture.

But, beyond reading the New Testament and some of the stories of early Christian martyrs, it can be daunting to figure out how to proceed. The complicated history of imperial Rome, along with the foreign names and locations featured in early Christian history, can make understanding the most important historical points difficult.

To uncover this fascinating history, we've produced our online course, "[Ancient Christianity](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zhb4pmku3u00dq042u0d09tu0v5090m5qptg1pfg_rp22sh2s8i6eob4chjmcpj4cth2bs)," now available on DVD.

In this course, Professor Kenneth Calvert is your guide through the first four centuries of Christianity as he explains the remarkable ways the new faith transformed the Roman world.

Would you help support this course so we can make it available to millions of Americans for free? As a token of our appreciation for your support, we'll send you a copy of our beautiful DVD Box Set for any donations of $100 or more.

body:
At age 6, Elijah Stacy was diagnosed with a fatal and incurable disease.

Friend,

_At age 6, Elijah Stacy was diagnosed with a fatal and incurable disease.
By age 11, Elijah lost his ability to walk.
Now, at age 23, Elijah is fighting for his life._

Elijah suffers from a rare genetic disease called Duchenne muscular dystrophy.

As a progressive muscle-wasting disease, Duchenne muscular dystrophy patients lose the ability to walk before age 12, lose arm functionality as a teenager, and face a tragically short lifespan, often passing away in their mid-twenties.

Elijah is fighting two important battles. Not only is he fighting for a cure, but he is also fighting against government bureaucrats standing in the way of his medical freedom. That’s why he supports Goldwater’s _Right to Try for Individualized Treatments_ — a new law that allows patients to access cutting-edge therapies based on their genetics.
_**“I support anything that gives people medical freedom. I support anything that allows us to accelerate.” - Elijah Stacy**_
I’m Victor Riches, President and CEO of the Goldwater Institute. At the Goldwater Institute, we know that people should be free to make their own decisions about their health and life.

The Right to Try for Individualized Treatments is a landmark reform that creates a pathway for Americans to access innovative, individualized treatments that have not yet received approval from the Food and Drug Administration.

**Although it has been enacted in six states, the Goldwater Institute is fighting to expand this legislation to every state.**

[The Goldwater Institute has a goal of $50,000 to pass the Right to Try for Individualized Treatments nationwide. Could you chip in $35, $50, $100, or even $10 to help give terminally ill patients the medical freedom they deserve?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zqierrnvbruasae308v5sms1vkdtqfob5na4hr10_rp22sh2s8i6eob4chjm6o32c5h2bs)

I don’t say this often with our policy proposals, but it’s true... the Right to Try for Individualized Treatments is saving lives, and it is an issue beyond partisanship.

The Goldwater Institute believes that personal health decisions should be made between patients and doctors, not bureaucrats in Washington, D.C.

By passing the Right to Try for Individualized Treatments, terminally ill patients have the opportunity to access potentially life-saving treatments. We are giving hope to many who feel the system is against them.

[Will you help us fight for the Right to Try for Individualized Treatments? Click here to show your support for medical freedom for terminally ill patients.>>>](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zq0hehb44bpta77hu88qrq1lp4trklt719fs4qr0_rp22sh2s8i6eob4chjm6o32c5h2bs)

Patients and their families should be free to make decisions that are best for them without first asking the government for permission.

**In Elijah’s words,_“If the patient wants it, if the company's willing to give it, and most importantly, in my opinion, the physician agrees with it, it's something that makes sense.”_**

---
| | | Elon Musk continues to wreak havoc on our government, slashing important programs he knows nothing about and firing employees at will. Now he's going after Social Security, spreading lies on social media about this essential service that millions of Americans rely on, and treating it like a plaything for half-baked experiments. Musk made completely bogus claims that millions of people over the age of 130 were receiving Social Security checks (not true) and called Social Security a "Ponzi scheme" and "the biggest fraud in the history of humanity." He's also working with Trump to make massive staffing cuts to the Social Security Administration – which will likely result in checks being delayed – or not showing up at all. The richest person in the world has no right to go after the essential benefits that Americans worked their whole lives to pay into. # **Last Night, Trump Showed Us Exactly Why We Fight.**
---
| [](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2wo8qf-vefubi-kyd76rh7/)
---
| | | | Dear friend, Last night, Donald Trump stood before Congress and tried to sell his warped vision of America. He declared “America is back,” but back to what? Back to open corruption? Back to blatant authoritarianism? Back to a government that serves billionaires like Elon Musk while gutting protections for everyday Americans? From the moment he stepped up to the podium, the night was a spectacle. Just three minutes in, Trump’s delusional claim that he won the popular vote by a “large margin” was met with loud boos from the chamber—so much so that Speaker Mike Johnson threatened to restore order by force. When that didn’t work, he sent in the Sergeant at Arms to remove a protester, as JD Vance literally jumped for joy at the chaos. This is what Republican leadership looks like now. Trump was eager to tout his record—bragging about signing over a hundred executive orders, a funny way to take credit for governing by fiat instead of working with Congress. He celebrated killing the electric vehicle mandate, yet government contracts for Tesla vehicles are bigger than ever, proving once again that Trump’s “anti-woke” crusade is just another grift. Rashida Tlaib called it out for what it is, holding up a sign that read **“Musk Steals.”** If last night made one thing clear, it’s this: Trump and his allies are done pretending. They aren’t governing—they’re ruling. They aren’t interested in democracy—they’re celebrating its destruction. We can’t let this be the future of our country. No Dem Left Behind is working to elect Democrats in every corner of the country—because we need leaders who will fight for real progress, not perform for a far-right audience. But we can’t do it without you. [**_Can you chip in $10, $25, or whatever you can today to help us defeat Trump and his enablers? Every dollar fuels the fight for democracy, for dignity, and for a government that actually works for the people._**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2wo8qf-vefubj-kyd76rh8/) Trump may think “America is back.” But with your help, we’ll make sure the country moves forward—not back to his dystopian vision. In Solidarity, The No Dem Left Behind Team

Learning about how early Christians worshipped and prayed, faced persecution and hardship, and settled theological disputes enriches our understanding of the faith. These lessons are especially important today, as Christians face increasing opposition from the culture.

clean_body: These lessons are especially important today, as Christians face increasing opposition from the culture. This sponsored message from Conservative Liberty Wire is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | | | Dear Friend, Learning about how early Christians worshipped and prayed, faced persecution and hardship, and settled theological disputes enriches our understanding of the faith. These lessons are especially important today, as Christians face increasing opposition from the culture. But, beyond reading the New Testament and some of the stories of early Christian martyrs, it can be daunting to figure out how to proceed. The complicated history of imperial Rome, along with the foreign names and locations featured in early Christian history, can make understanding the most important historical points difficult. To uncover this fascinating history, we've produced our online course, "," now available on DVD. In this course, Professor Kenneth Calvert is your guide through the first four centuries of Christianity as he explains the remarkable ways the new faith transformed the Roman world. Would you help support this course so we can make it available to millions of Americans for free? As a token of our appreciation for your support, we'll send you a copy of our beautiful DVD Box Set for any donations of $100 or more. body:
Yes – the rumors are true. I’ve got some major news for you!

Yes – the rumors are true. I’ve got some major news for you!
I wrote you a note with everything you need to know right now.
| |
---
| | | Hi, it's Vivek.

I wanted you to hear this directly from me: I JUST announced my candidacy for Governor of Ohio.

**[In a moment, I'm going to ask you to become a Founding Donor to this historic campaign - but first, I'd like to explain why if you'll indulge me for a moment.](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews. "I’ll be making a special announcement soon and after everything we’ve been through together, I want you to be the first to hear.")**

---
** WHY RUN NOW? **
---
President Trump winning re-election in November was not just another political victory - it was a seismic realignment for our country. He won every swing state. He improved his vote share of minorities and young voters. We won the House AND Senate. And heck, he even won the popular vote.

It was the honor of a lifetime to rally voters in battleground states, campaign on college campuses to turn out Gen-Z for Trump, and promote his America First vision at rally after rally.

---
| | | | [](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.)
---
| | [](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews._6XCWROIWORCzA)
---
Right now, we have a once-in-a-generation chance to make real, lasting change to the country we know and love. It's an opportunity to not just ticker around the edges of the Federal Government, but to upend it completely.

This is our moment to GUT the managerial bureaucracy, FIRE anyone connected to the weaponization of our own government against us, SLASH the size and scope of the administrative state, and usher in the GOLDEN AGE for America!

But the Deep State is already putting up the fight of its life. They're resisting change at every turn. Make no mistake - we can't afford to squander this historic opportunity. That's why President Trump needs trusted partnerships at the state level RIGHT NOW!

---
** WHY OHIO? **
---
This one's easy. I was born and raised here in the Buckeye State and graduated from St. Xavier - a Catholic high school in Cincinnati. My wife, Apporva, and I live outside Columbus, raising our two boys here. I've started multiple businesses in Ohio. I've also known JD Vance since college and campaigned all over the state for our excellent new Senator, Bernie Moreno.
---
| | | | [](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews._XFxIQIddMqbGNw)
---
| | [](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews._3Gg)
---
The people here are honest, have steel in their spines, and embody the City on a Hill spirit that our country was founded upon. [As Governor, I'd be honored to represent them and the values they stand for.](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews._GJ-YRKPeTLn6g "As Governor, I’d be honored to represent them and the values they stand for.")

---
** WHY GOVERNOR? **
---
Having traveled across the country, met with hundreds of politicians, ran multiple businesses, and seen how deals really get cut in The Swamp, I have never been more certain that REAL change only gets done with buy-in at the executive level.

We saw up close and personal the failure of Democrat rule with Joe Biden in control of the Federal Government. We also see Democrat governors like Gavin Newsom and Kathy Hochul drive their states into ruin. On the other hand, we now see President Trump act quickly and decisively to fix our country by deporting illegal criminals, moving to cut taxes, securing our border, gutting DEI, and obliterating the Deep State. True leadership can change everything.
---
| | | | [](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.)
---
| | [](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews._A8kJw9nv0wPBAYhmY7HZw)
---
That's why I'm running for Governor in my home state of Ohio. I will partner with President Trump - just like I did on the campaign trail - at the state level to Make America Great Again. [I will be a change agent for our state and set an example of efficient, conservative governance for the rest of the country.](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews. "I will be a change agent for our state and set an example of efficient, conservative governance for the rest of the country.")

So there you have it. That's the "why" behind my run for Governor.

**[It would be the honor of a lifetime to have your support now that I've officially launched my campaign. I'm humbly asking you to become a Founding Donor today with a gift of any size.](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews. "It would be the honor of a lifetime to have your support now that I’ve officially launched my campaign. I’m humbly asking you to become a Founding Donor today with a gift of any size.")**

---
| | [**CONTRIBUTE $4 HERE** ](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.)
---
| | [**CONTRIBUTE $40 HERE** ](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.)
---
| | [**CONTRIBUTE $400 HERE** ](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.)
---
| | [**CONTRIBUTE ANY AMOUNT** ](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.-X-GsR_Dg)
---

Thanks for taking a minute to read this email. I appreciate your time.

God bless you and God bless America,
Vivek Ramaswamy

---

Columbus, OH 43201

John Adams believed that "on that night, the foundation of American independence was laid." To our prehistoric ancestors, a woolly mammoth must have been an awesome sight. ## Trump Promises 'Our Greatest Era'
President Trump delivered the longest presidential address in history Tuesday night, [emphasizing the American dream](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOtCAUhZ8GOwxcFMaC4m_s5m-3NIxc9G5QDDDjzttvnH67k5zknC_f1326O4q0L__dhraGNIGAngvFRT95R_E9dY23ARFQNWil6aQ0qu-GZrW3eTAOneogDHIACL1HIbR0KqDWSjdkrzWhRC-l1KBaM8ubUsL0D6GFfgDrBHqqKbffifa6Yojv9MLczmlrol1rPQpT_xiMDMbzPNuQfnY8y9UzGI8UqdJcGIw1P7eDHzltVLDwulLh6Zn5ktFVLJVjdvxzwp33GUvhc9qXKzTZ-uOkGKlowzqxbI7ih6D-ZeRl4TcAAP__nddk_A) and highlighting his administration's accomplishments in its first six weeks. Trump [touched on immigration policy](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGPozAQhX-N6SayxxiSwsU1dLn2SmTwEHwxNvI4YfPvV2y_zdOTPunT0_t3H-8uxJAef91Gti55RIkGpAZpRu9C_Ixt4-1ChKQbsqpvleq1aW_Nahff4UQ06dtirkZqZ9Dcrq5ffN95NZkm2NMmtTRKqQ71pZ_VVWvZm0l2sptQtJJ8qLlc_ueQ6kpL_OQ3lcuctybatdadhf4jcBA4pM-euZ5I4HCKBQ5Sn9EKHF4MiQ4WONTy2nZYXYgMxxpKPELywOELDqIng2OY87blBEyJCQq9c3zVkNOJPG0MK83PSOCSh73kSlzBeV-IGWqGOafH2QUOTbF-P0KMgbtetPKxuRB_1tff3nxb_A4AAP__uPF4Tw), energy plans, efforts to end diversity programs in government, and asked people to give his tariff policy time to work. The President emphasized eliminating waste and fraud in government while urging Congress to pass legislation cutting taxes for Americans and eliminating taxes on tips and overtime. The speech met with open Democratic Party opposition. One, Rep. Al Green, was [ejected from the chamber by the Sgt.-at-Arms. ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0z7tuhDAQheGnsbtF4_FtU7hIQ7dpUyJjxuxEBq_AWsTbR6RPd6QjfdL__RgekQuv81dcKLRcBwS0N9A3sMMUuZyDkVPIREhaUlDeKOW1NR_yGSJCTimnu0NI0aAjR4Q2eswZwBjJ4dJAg1VKOdSdT-quNXg7ggM3ojBAE7e6dT-V1_akXM76pq1LdZElPFt77UJ_CuwF9sdxdOOYrk9gv9KxC-zj1jgVumayJ_i5nDPpKrcwvQ4uhXfnhYF5iVz-1PZf5TvgbwAAAP___qlS6w)
## Canada, China Retaliate on Tariffs
[President Trump imposed](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00L-OszAQBPCnMZ3R-h-EwsXX0OVrr0SLvQSfTED2Jihvf-L6a6YZ6TfSfN2nO6acno__uJHnZZ80aCfBSHBTxJQ_k22iX4g0mYa86q1SvXF2aFZvwQ6DdTiTg7hEDNHBLQSnAgwKHTTJXxoYcEqpTpu2D-pmDPRuhg66WQsLFBPvpf3e05NXWvJnf1Npw7412a_MRxXmn9Cj0ON5nm14zuEqhR4vWugRzBVW6JHLazuqZCxpWaqsjIXlI-8zZskFI8mc3iRfR0Sm2q685ab4eJwp51S7Xlh4bJjy7zj_dcbb658AAAD__1I9X_E) a 25% tariff on imports from Canada and Mexico Tuesday, with Canadian energy products taxed at 10%, while tariffs on Chinese goods were raised to 20%. Canada and China responded with retaliatory tariffs, with Prime Minister Justin Trudeau announcing duties on over $100 billion in U.S. goods. [Watch Trudeau's statement here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO6yAQAL8Gd1iwGGMXFK9xl9deaYFZJ3vCEAGxlb8_5fqrRxqN5uu23hxFSvf_7kDb9ryCAM2F4kKvwVF8r0MX7I4IqDq00gxSGqWHuXvYMHuY0MnZg1dqGz3CPDmz7V5sMM7Ykf3YhBJaSjmC6s0mJ6WE0V6MYvTABoGBWi79d6bUHrjHdz6x9Fs-umgfrT0rU_8YLAyW67r65LeEV_1wBstJATODpZVXQPfiASOdWCqvDUviB9bq7shb5q28jifPiTdXaN8rB6UGPRlt9KS7YsPzohipjoYN4n44ir8J7a8lp4WfAAAA___6w2Ng). Late Tuesday, Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick said President Trump [may announce a compromise](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kD1vgzAUAH-N2Rz5A2w6eOjClq4d0Yv9CK_1BzJOKP--SvfOJ51O93mdr0CR8v0DErq2lFkJNXChuRjmABTPue-CWxAV6g6dtL2UVg_9W7e6RfSgR6-lUOBxDMMSvLQ4Wu21MkZ25F42ocUgpTRKX6yXo9bCDjdhhLkp1gsM1Eq9fBXKbcUlnuWJ9eJL6qJbW9t2pt-Zmpia2oorxfhiTE1rSZjx2JmaICTKtLcKjUpmahqkNdJYHh8tk__mrT7SxhOcHHIuj-yRN6i0LNyXtNWSaEd-UFu5hwwBeMIf8oWXzA8MGfcAJ1NTV13YDoqRdmNZL-4J6C-na_-tezr1GwAA__-ySHKK) with Canada and Mexico today. Look - this is from the bottom of my heart, so please read this message to the end. My team and I put together a historic win in 2021 to help flip all three of Virginia's highest offices red. Ever since becoming Lt. Governor, I've been logging big wins for my friends, neighbors, and every fellow Virginian. Now, I'm running for Governor so we can continue to keep up the amazing work we've been doing here in the Commonwealth and make history again. But right now I have a few SERIOUS challenges: I was legally barred from accepting even a dime in support of my campaign while I was in the Virginia legislative session. But my Democrat opponent, Abigail Spanberger, has been fundraising BIG TIME while I've been working hard in our capital. Seriously , a far-Left group injected $500K into Abigail Spanberger 's campaign coffers and there wasn't a thing I could do in response! Now Spanberger has an ENORMOUS fundraising advantage, Friend. Polls show this race is tied, but Spanberger has a serious cash advantage.If we don 't make up the difference, our conservative mission will be cut short. Today, I 'm making a plea to you as a Christian, a mother, and a Marine; please send in any amount you can spare to support my campaign! | | Without your support, we will fall even further behind. A Dallas biotech company has produced genetically engineered "woolly mice," and even though they're "much cuter" than anticipated, you can't get one for a pet. ## Austin Welcomes Waymo Robotaxi Service
A robotaxi service operated by ridesharing app Uber and Google affiliate Waymo [expanded to Austin on Tuesday](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLuOgzAURL_GdEa-fgRSuNiGLttuify4BksGR7YTyN-v2H6bmeJIR6P5ecwPE1Pcl2-zoW5nyDNnXFEmKFOzNzF9Ztl5bZm_Q4caBgkw3IBBt2oIygVnwPoRQDHJlJSIUtyFM55x2UV9yZhgCkCNaugRx1G6AdA6c4ebIJKhjy2Xvq3Y8DQ1pE9-Y-ld3rqk19aelYgvwifCp-M4erdbd0HCp8tN-MTEFfLi5rNl-rJYqMUl7jSHgCXuCy3Z5mbOSEv0WGncqXnVdtWKxtMcaD3r0a9tS13R_nnElGK9DUSyZTMx_c1p__7z1vw3AAD__6usZ9E), just in time for the annual SXSW tech festival, which is expected to bring 300,000 people to the Texas capital over the next week and a half. The service already provides 200,000 paid rides a week in San Francisco, Los Angeles, and Phoenix, and it is expected to [launch in Atlanta later this year](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLtuxCAURL8Gd6wAgx8FRRp3mzalheHaXAmbFVzv4-8jp08zU4x0NDo_9_nuMOGxfbsdLL3XPCuhDBctF2YODtNn1k2wiwijbMDKXkvZd1LIJtohjD6MQQSt2kWJEFbTy1GD6szqYNUN2gsmWmGkNIPpbwDDoH0vYfFulF3LtICAlMuNIhC8XV3TJz-h3Hzem2Qj0aOy9oupiamJwEdfzsPHa2ZquuhMTaK9QjM1nQsUflYolePB3VnpqgJ8AyI8Nr478hECfyFF_nKfPfOSl0zujZWpqSk2PF6YEtauZ1psu8P094X-lfO06jcAAP___ThnMw). Uber customers matched with a Waymo vehicle can choose to accept or decline the ride and are not expected to tip. Andrew Macdonald, Uber’s senior vice president of mobility, said Austin’s demographics and appetite for tech provide a [prime market for the service](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvgzAUhH8NbEa2wRgGD12ypWtH9MDPyVMNjuyXEP59RTt3O-m-O53u6zpdgSJtt09Y0fE7pElLbYRshTSTB4rH1NXezdKPqkanbKeU7ZVU9d1Bq_xgFuxH8Bb0bIM3gx6XYQxKGpQ1ubNMttIoZQZjG8Rh6BarcF5gVH1bdRI9ccoN35HxDSXEI70wN0ta6-juzI9StR-VvlT6su978_2G7TQrfeEMIdDyp7bySJmBKW0nCceaxHPGLNLJEMR4iJxiFOnJwmd6YY5YisjksQjaBDwL05mts_OPnWKk0tuqk7cVKP7u4X8Pejn9EwAA__8Gzmt0). "_It’s tech-friendly, it’s young, it’s got lots of tourists and travelers and big events. So the consumer demand is there._ " Austin customers can use the service to travel to [destinations within a 37-square-mile area](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00LuOgzAQheGnMZ2jGdvcChfb0GXbLdEYD8GSwcg4IXn7Fdtv_-kc6f-5j3cKMWyPb1rZlvecRgWqlqAl1KOnED-jqbx14Hus2GJrENsGAavFdu2sPaHT_dz14GvgbjLKgOvReDBcBXuNgYYase7q9sbcdWZqkd1EPTZaGGAfSsq3snDhNx1z_KQX59uU1irapZT9EPpLqEGo4TzPy704P_gCQg0bn4dQQ6O0BnUR-qxJPh1nSc-jhE3m5FKhd5C07zLSc5uWKlu_nyHGcDStMPBYKcS_x_JvgpdVvwEAAP__v1FeVQ). Tesla has announced it will debut its CyberCab robotaxi service in Austin in June.
## Dallas Startup Introduces 'Woolly Mice'
Dallas startup Colossal Biosciences has announced the [birth of 38 genetically engineered “woolly mice”](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHOpCAURp8Gu2sAYXAKChu72XZLg3oVssCdCDOOb7-Zv_-rr_iSk5Pz9zE9XIgh739cQls_G02SSw28A66n1YV4TapZ7czXu2jQCqOEMDfBReMtzl2PCjU3Xed6o4TRG1da695tQq1bE-wXxjuuhdC9Ni1i36vFCJwXdxe3jimOa6h0tNVjxY8rW7zojUe7UGqi9bU-C-sGJkcmx_M821Ty92NyxAyvwuSY8fxOxcVnirRfTI4JscJCkUpxEQqcRDFekOhVEBzMB7p_1R_02j2EDMmlRNXDioCfGvJSA2UmR3fAMIhhQ6Obw67PM8QYys0wxffkQvyxrL9me1v5PwAA__-CzXFT) in a proof-of-concept demonstration of the company’s de-extinction model, which researchers plan to use to resurrect the woolly mammoth. Scientists edited seven genes in the mice that affect their metabolism, fur length, texture, and color. Pending approval from the Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee, the team plans to [test the mice’s adaptability to a cold climate](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFuwyAURb8Gb1iAjTEDQxdv6drRwvAc00KI4CXEf1-le6c7XOno6Hxd1osNMdyunzaBwdeeV8GEpGygTK7ehniuY-fNxrzmHRiuRs7VxBnvDsNna0GM3rFdKgFs2jatPUitnd214l0wbxgbmORczlL1APM8OsVhc1bzaSAjAx8wlx4PQHjZusczP6H0LqcumgPxXsnwQcRCxNJa61so4N8vEUvFXM73ugA3DBUr_X5UpK6ARfDU0pZzjCdN-VGBtoAHTTaljAeN4Qfo_ihELF0x_t5CjKFOiozsmmyIfwL4b5GnEb8BAAD__9q3Zd0). Dr. Beth Shapiro, chief science officer at Colossal, called the achievement "an important step toward validating our approach to resurrecting traits that have been lost to extinction and that our goal is to restore." Researchers aim to produce a woolly mammoth by replicating the process in elephant DNA. ## World's Largest Sea Turtle Hospital
The world’s [largest sea turtle hospital](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L2u4yAQxfGnwR0RYPyRgmIbd3fbLS3iGcxIkxDBJE7efpX0t__p6Oj_72f9icR02__GKwZ5pbI64wZtem2GFSLxe_UdhIuBs-0w2MlbO43W2C6HFJ03EM8JehztOCdIJk7eOjSQNnAdhc-Y6c1g7TAP0wlxnv02Wbxs8WzHXnmDQFLqSTIKvmJL_C5PrKetXDsOWeTeVP9HuUW55Qsy7fmI7_YRyi3lIVBKbcotBzEwJVRuoVsjQC0Z9VEqQ9Mc645NdMOo5VGFUefS7iSRlVu6GuB-EDO1cVLe7NdI_P0gv0Z5Bvc_AAD__3R5Z3c) opened Saturday on South Padre Island, home to the nonprofit Sea Turtle Inc. body:
I am doing everything I can to save our country.

| | | | |
---
Friend – I have spent some of the best years of my life fighting to save America from the radical left that wants to destroy it and sometimes, I’ve put that fight over the things I cherish the most.
I’ve missed birthdays, special occasions, and reunions...
I’ve come home completely exhausted from trying to secure victory in states far away from my home for **President Trump** and **our GOP majority**.
My dad served our country in the military, and he taught me how to love our country the way he does.
He still calls my mom his “bride” and I know that even when I don’t see him for months at a time, he understands the importance of **the work Early Vote Action does**.
My mom put everything she had into raising our family, and even today, she still puts everything she has into taking care of all of us.
I miss my family... But I would not change a single thing about the past few years, and **__[I will never give up this fight](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a6ep/?__vbtrk=Mjc4MzU5OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc4MzU5OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_._**
Someday, all of this is going to end. We will have transformed the Republican Party to always put America First. We will have successfully fought to drop unlawful voters from states’ voter rolls. We will have transformed voter demographics, and mobilized enough voters to save our country, once and for all.
That is, at least, _**my hope**_ , and **my dream**.
We ****_delivered Pennsylvania for President Trump_**. We were instrumental in _**revamping the RNC**_. We are so close to _**transforming New Jersey**_ into a red state that I can feel it.**
The support from patriots like you was instrumental in all of those victories, and we’re still not done. Without your support, we wouldn’t have accomplished any of what we’ve done so far.
I have given my life to this. If you believe this is still a cause worth fighting for, I hope you’ll chip in to help me keep doing it full time.
**__[Can I count on you to keep us in this fight](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a6ep/?__vbtrk=Mjc4MzU5OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc4MzU5OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_?_**

_Forever Fighting,_

**Scott Presler** Founder, Early Vote Action

| | Dear Friend,

Learning about how early Christians worshipped and prayed, faced persecution and hardship, and settled theological disputes enriches our understanding of the faith. These lessons are especially important today, as Christians face increasing opposition from the culture.

But, beyond reading the New Testament and some of the stories of early Christian martyrs, it can be daunting to figure out how to proceed. The complicated history of imperial Rome, along with the foreign names and locations featured in early Christian history, can make understanding the most important historical points difficult.

To uncover this fascinating history, we've produced our online course, "[Ancient Christianity](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=b055f60b43fc40beaad4aa2231fcbf3b&_e=Hf8qyb_NA5NRIKdS26QQd54xsMs-szkVsu8LU4YT8BpwU8vVonLOmN4KjnKcaHqUp9QgMWUFbP8AdNQW_LbqkB2nOLc69ycCNF6Y3Un7Ipg2Q_jduFSa6Ba9RS1iG3BQ0dZI-eAndx2Y0E92i0mqyKFVtd1tuAITLt-Kujq9YkvjWL_a8mdI4_DhBsw783REdgQvs6555bFAzyBH-SJI_NBqehvYTPD_5Aa0VSKwGLDql-h5BnJyhaeQbfRuT77mtcOkGP8OYcOCa0RHdOfL9QBPXQaj_jRoVBMawC_RifP1OhdvvF-U7dqAzYdUg_nzNk6OfsejLSYSWECEQn9unm9MFB2GtDjT6CkBhu1ZNDZrVjF9FjekDux1W5x_uJvzEdK2st5lbOLrO--QF1YpZGUNyeUv1shPbE_VcQ0MRBE1z5T_LTFjG2E81wkrASRA)," now available on DVD.

When forming a mental picture of George Washington, many of us likely flip through the brain rolodex to recall a portrait of the founding father staring back at viewers in a stately manner or calmly seated before the Continental Congress.

# [George Washington's dentures were made from, among other things, hippo tusks.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssngik&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Famous Figures](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssngik&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssngik&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| W hen forming a mental picture of George Washington, many of us likely flip through the brain rolodex to recall a portrait of the founding father staring back at viewers in a stately manner or calmly seated before the Continental Congress. However, these cool-as-a-cucumber depictions marked a stark contrast to reality, as Washington was often in pain from the [tooth problems](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssngik&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) he endured for most of his adult years.
---
Whether due to childhood neglect, poor diet, or genetics, Washington had his first tooth pulled at age 24 and spent the rest of his life trying to play catch-up with fastidious attention to oral health. It wound up being a losing battle, as he was saving his pulled teeth for use in dentures by his early 50s. While real human teeth were a prize component of dentures, Washington accepted sets that included animal teeth as well as lead-tin, copper, and silver alloys — though notably not wood, as is often erroneously reported. By the time of his inauguration in 1789, the first U.S. president was wearing a customized set of dentures, built by New York dentist John Greenwood, that featured [hippopotamus ivory](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssngik&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) and an array of gold wire springs and brass screws to hold its human teeth in place.
Unfortunately, the access to cutting-edge dental technology didn't translate to an improved quality of life for Washington, who dashed off a series of letters to his dentist in later years that complained of the discomfort and bulging caused by his dentures. Still, the general seemed to realize there was little that could be done in this longtime war of attrition within his mouth, and when his final real tooth needed to be pulled in 1796, he gifted it to Dr. Greenwood.
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssngik&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) | [](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssngik&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

## Paul Revere was a part-time dentist.
Remembered by students nowadays for his midnight ride at the onset of the American Revolution, Paul Revere was largely known to fellow citizens of Massachusetts in the late 18th and early 19th centuries for his trade as a silversmith. However, when the end of the French and Indian War ignited an economic depression in the 1760s, the famed patriot took on an array of side hustles that included stints as a copperplate engraver, an illustrator, and even a [dentist](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=ssngik&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com). Having learned the tools of the trade from a local practitioner named John Baker, Revere placed a pair of advertisements for his services in the _Boston-Gazette_ , the second of which boasted of his record of having "fixt some hundreds of teeth." Although Revere was seemingly finished with dentistry around the time the war commenced, his handiwork proved helpful in the aftermath of the June 1775 Battle of Bunker Hill. Identifying one body as that of Joseph Warren due to the walrus tooth and wire he had inserted, Revere helped ensure the beloved local leader had a proper burial, and as such added one more title to his already expansive résumé: the country's first forensic dentist.

# "AMERICA IS BACK"
---
| Did you watch President Trump speak last night as he addressed a joint session of Congress at the US Capitol?
It was truly a riveting 2 hours of Trump listing off undeniable accomplishment after accomplishment that he's done for the American people in record time. The theme of President Trump's address was "The Renewal of the American Dream," and it included highlights of what his administration has done so far, including economic policy, border security and foreign policy plans.
President Trump is putting America first, as he promised, not last, in all American policy from border policies, to energy policy, to trade policies. He mentioned this was a mandate by the American people, as he referenced winning the popular vote in November. President Trump stated, "the people elected me to do a job and I'm doing it."
In fact, he said his first month in office he stated that he was more successful than any other president in our history, including legendary President George Washington.
Here are a few highlights:
* Declare a national emergency on our southern border. His administration has "launched the most sweeping border and immigration crackdown in American history." Illegal border crossings are at their lowest levels ever.
* Pursue a dramatic overhaul of the federal bureaucracy and a [cost-cutting](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001nIKTTBKXWdTQEkrDdAVzHS-Aq10a7DnM1mOkVID82RI7X_-Iz1BHjdYAYr_Cpfvkceq1nol6YnOPLQoW9_09WI_ZQLuYLqOjJqNu3cGwOw-jnE1GPpgsfNWDe8fMeAHJvs8iRV3Tpk9KV6Z9XMedJvR1drWS_PshppHqy0D9uWiefWsMyXfmJiaLAKz4EBq2fKpjSFf9gcvFj1Sir0rg0KDpOYTRohNNZFvUdvWLgWHYQiuu-Rtkew==&c=ST2-KcPyLfZx2WFqE5SAeIzA1XQrx9SZHV99arcnogQtVcjH17gMXQ==&ch=AAyxvTusV_3wP5qtQXD8ZE3YamqudGDzKF2cuUA_UOoSL_X2IGhkmA==) effort alongside Elon Musk, who he's tapped to lead the Department of Government Efficiency. DOGE has been working with Cabinet department and agency heads to shrink the government workforce, while [halting](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001nIKTTBKXWdTQEkrDdAVzHS-Aq10a7DnM1mOkVID82RI7X_-Iz1BHjdYAYr_CpfvkTatc8PB291fIdEBpxkIdH0_mcgq7cHErktRYRNz_9JePn4fyQ7XbglXXQb25CtVTx4qKy7ahzJdJ5Le_3b9IyLprv9OERD9Re-N-UnXEAjqv_qCvLn2xT-aokz04y53NZ-j2EAaDlHe2PeYWDmLF2ZomGGTlCYms0p3rv22OPiIk3deixgKwxdhP1ZId3TaZ&c=ST2-KcPyLfZx2WFqE5SAeIzA1XQrx9SZHV99arcnogQtVcjH17gMXQ==&ch=AAyxvTusV_3wP5qtQXD8ZE3YamqudGDzKF2cuUA_UOoSL_X2IGhkmA==) swaths of [government spending](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001nIKTTBKXWdTQEkrDdAVzHS-Aq10a7DnM1mOkVID82RI7X_-Iz1BHjdYAYr_Cpfvkfdb1faLcnKLBO3bqkXWogaWERuCV8sfL62naXwsk0bQ6qRL-V6jyKQ16sW2OAwSOv3WAjG9j7t2qk4u9kPNqhaIdFBawzcfP2uRpitsIcd0qAr3_MGzEtzNMwXDhoE9GWo-HkCtiBQA=&c=ST2-KcPyLfZx2WFqE5SAeIzA1XQrx9SZHV99arcnogQtVcjH17gMXQ==&ch=AAyxvTusV_3wP5qtQXD8ZE3YamqudGDzKF2cuUA_UOoSL_X2IGhkmA==). They have exposed billions of dollars in fraud, waste, abuse and even theft.
* Use tariffs to bring businesses back to the US and to ensure we get an equitable deal with other countries, who have taken advantage of America in the past. The U.S. has imposed 25% tariffs on Mexican and Canadian imports, and raised existing tariffs on Chinese products to 20%.
* End the war in Ukraine. Trump said Tuesday he received a letter from Zelenskyy stating that Ukraine is ready to negotiate and resume peace talks, and would sign a rare-earth minerals deal and continue peace negotiations to end the war with Russia.
* He also mentioned that his administration has caught the terrorist behind an attack in Afghanistan that resulted in the death of 13 U.S. troops

And here are things to come:
* Trump revealed that he plans to launch a "Golden Dome" defense shield initiative for the U.S., similar to the one Israel has protecting itself.
* Trump also unveiled plans for legal citizenship, announcing that a $5 million "gold card" will become available in the near future and would allow "successful, job-creating people" to purchase their way to U.S. citizenship.

Presidents typically address a joint session of Congress early in their term to outline their vision or agenda. The first speech before lawmakers is not technically a State of the Union, but rather an Address to a Joint Session of Congress.
The joint session started shortly after 9pm and ended at 11pm, which incidentally makes it the longest address to a joint session of Congress since at least 1964, including State of the Union speeches.
It's no surprise though, because President Trump has already racked up so many monumental accomplishments, that it took awhile just to get through all of them.
In his remarks, Trump said, "the American dream is surging bigger and better than ever before." Virginians everywhere are excited that someone is finally doing something about the inefficiency we've come to expect from Uncle Sam. The fraud, waste, abuse and even theft has been staggering. But President Trump and his administration have committed to doing everything they can in record time to reverse this.
President [Donald Trump](https://byh4wqwab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001nIKTTBKXWdTQEkrDdAVzHS-Aq10a7DnM1mOkVID82RI7X_-Iz1BHjdYAYr_CpfvkqM1k4sUjDn5ZOiZyt34Rtko-3wy_ejYNHRmj74nkJI2ByaVAIZrMbFF_I7TF7Bg2t0rZTbLVDfkzwu0vciWg-8qOS-rsGj2bkx3lPfShDcHaSvcNeLg1QBbalsHqhswQ&c=ST2-KcPyLfZx2WFqE5SAeIzA1XQrx9SZHV99arcnogQtVcjH17gMXQ==&ch=AAyxvTusV_3wP5qtQXD8ZE3YamqudGDzKF2cuUA_UOoSL_X2IGhkmA==) vowed in a speech to Congress and the U.S. that his administration would work to take "America's destiny into our own hands" and promised that "this will be our greatest era" where he would fight to forge the most free civilization.
Trump's remarks came as he delivered an address to a joint session of Congress Tuesday in a speech similar to the annual State of the Union, where he declared that "America is back" and that the "American dream is surging."

| Dear Hello Many of you have pleaded with me to run for governor and promised to vote for me.
I said yes, but only if you help me. In order for you to vote for me on June 17, you must help me collect the signatures of your family and friends so that I can get on the ballot.
To even get my name on the ballot, I need at least 10,000 valid signatures, 400 in each of the 11 Congressional Districts before April 3.
That's one month.
With such little time to organize, I'm counting on the grassroots to collect the signatures. And many of you are. Thank you. Please reply to this email and let us know where you are collecting so we can best focus our efforts.
Do you want a Governor who is like Trump, one who doesn't kowtow to the political establishment and actually stands up for you?
Many of you have emphatically pleaded with me to run again stating, "We need a MAGA candidate for Governor, who we can vote for."
Many want a Trump candidate for governor.
Many of you remember that I ran for Governor in 2020-2021, for 18 months as the pro-Trump candidate.
In fact, many of you called me "Trump in Heels."
I did well in the 9 candidate ranked choice convention. I finished 3rd, ahead of a popular former Speaker of the House. Many believed that had it been a primary, that I would have won.
The Republican nomination coming up this June 17th will be a primary. I was the deciding vote in the Senate to make sure it was a primary and not a convention. Thanks to my vote, you will be able to go to your local polling location between the hours of 6am and 7pm to vote.
Unfortunately, WE CANNOT COLLECT SIGNATURES ONLINE. Signatures must be witnessed in person by signing an old fashioned paper petition ballot.
So here's the deal.
If those of you who want me to run for Governor will collect the necessary signatures to get my name on the ballot by the deadline, I will run. If not, then I won't.
This requires you to do some work:
1. Print off the attached form on one sheet of paper, front and back.
2. Witness your friends, family and neighbors sign the petition form. Please make sure they actually sign the form. Please also make sure their writing is legible so that signatures can be verified.

5. Get the petition notarized.
6. Drop the petition off in person to: 2023 Church Street, Appomattox, VA 24522

| | Dear Friends,

Over the decades, we have seen Congressman Turner's commitment to the community as a Texas State Representative, Mayor of Houston, and United States Representative. His decades of public service have made a huge impact in our community. We will all miss Congressman Turner's devotion to the people. May he rest in peace.

**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi everyone,
What a speech from President Trump last night! We are witnessing the dawn of a new _GOLDEN_ era for America—bold leadership, real results, and a vision that puts _We the People_ first. Rocky Mountain Voice will be here every step of the way, keeping you informed and plugged in as history unfolds! Here is a summary of today's top stories:
**🏛️ Colorado Legislative Session Updates...** Rep. Ken DeGraaf criticized a [stove-labeling bill](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) as symbolic overreach, while a grassroots effort works to [protect parental rights](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) through a ballot initiative and moving the needle on bills. Gun advocates oppose HB 1133 and SB 3, arguing they unfairly [target legal gun owners](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Meanwhile, lawmakers rejected [stricter emissions reporting](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) but approved a study on environmental regulations' impact on jobs.
**🏔️ Here in Colorado...** Reps. Lauren Boebert and Gabe Evans will confront Denver Mayor Mike Johnston in a congressional hearing over [sanctuary city policies](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and crime. At President Trump’s Joint Congress Address, Rep. Gabe Evans was joined by the mother of a [Northern Colorado fentanyl victim](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), highlighting the deadly consequences of lax border policies.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** New tariffs on Canada, Mexico, and China [take effect this weekend](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to curb drug trafficking and protect jobs. Linda McMahon, now [Education Secretary](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), pledges to dismantle DEI and expand school choice.
🗣️**Commentary Spotlight...** A new op-ed explores how government programs [marketed as "free"](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) often lead to higher costs and unintended consequences for taxpayers. A deep dive into ongoing efforts to protect medical professionals from being forced to perform procedures [against their beliefs](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, March 5, 2025.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|

**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Reps. Boebert, Evans to faceoff with Denver Mayor Mike Johnston in hearing Wednesday](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY BRIAN PORTER, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
The national spotlight will shine brightly on Denver and Mayor Mike Johnston’s sanctuary city policies during the U.S. House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform on Wednesday.
He’s among American mayors who will appear in front of the Committee.
Across the dias will be Committee member U.S. Rep. Lauren Boebert and Committee waiver U.S. Rep. Gabe Evans, two Coloradans who have had a front row seat to the rise in fentanyl deaths, crime, gang influence and more they likely will attribute to having been caused by sanctuary policies.
“We are going to highlight how these sanctuary city and state policies fail public safety, make America less safe, and why we need to continue the path forward to build safe communities that we all deserve,” Evans said Tuesday in a press conference in advance of the hearing.
