**[‘Who’s that who sat next to Gabe Evans at Trump’s speech?’ It was the mother of a Northern Colorado fentanyl victim](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Rep. Gabe Evans invited Liz Hardy, the mother of a Northern Colorado fentanyl victim, to President Trump's Address to the Nation to highlight the dangers of fentanyl trafficking.
* Hardy’s daughter, Brooke, tragically died in 2022 after taking half of a counterfeit pill laced with fentanyl, prompting her family to advocate for stronger enforcement against drug traffickers.
* Evans, a former police officer, has been actively pushing for the HALT Fentanyl Act to strengthen law enforcement’s ability to combat fentanyl distribution and protect communities from the ongoing crisis.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Protect Kids Colorado working toward ballot initiative, ‘moving the needle’ on bills, co-founder Erin Lee says](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Protect Kids Colorado is gearing up for another ballot initiative this summer, aiming to safeguard parental rights and push back against radical policies in schools and healthcare.
* The group has been actively testifying in the Colorado Legislature, supporting bills like the Youth Health Protection Act while opposing measures promoting gender-affirming treatments for minors.
* Co-founder Erin Lee emphasized that showing up in numbers is making a difference, as legislators are being forced to confront opposition outside their usual activist circles.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Boll: Colorado’s battle to protect kids and conscience in Healthcare. First, do no harm](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_If you’re at all interested in ensuring that the future of Colorado’s healthcare system is enshrined in the tenets of the Hippocratic Oath — including practicing with integrity and competence — and that parental authority is respected in the realm of health care for children, then you’ll want to pay attention to several bills that will be in front of the Colorado legislature this week._
_Colorado has positioned itself as a leader in protecting access to gender-affirming care (President Trump’s Executive Order refers to this ‘care’ as chemical and surgical mutilation) and abortion._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Walcher: Paying for what ought to be free](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_If I offered you a thousand dollars not to steal my car, would you be any less likely to steal it? What if I offered you a million? If you’re like most people, you would answer that you weren’t planning to steal it anyway. You’re not a thief so the discussion is pointless. Although if I were serious, you might take the money anyway._
_That isn’t much different than some of the revelations of government grants we are learning about through recent DOGE discoveries, controversial though they are. I’m just looking at grants related to natural resources and the environment, but can’t help wondering why the government has been paying so much to so many organizations and companies – to do what they were doing anyway._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**

Ken Degraaf criticized House Bill 25-1161 before it was passed out of the chamber on party lines._ __

**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY BRIAN PORTER****| STATE | MARCH 3** _Veterinarians are in extremely short supply in all four corners of Colorado._ _The solution? The authors of House Bill 25-1131 say, ironically, a veterinarian shortage can be fixed through the graduation of more veterinarians._ __

body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=39485%2E3422442%2EwVJfZK)
Derek,
Last night was Trump’s first speech to Congress of his second term. He spoke for 99 minutes (the longest one in history), but he had very little to show for it.
What I hoped—but didn’t expect—to hear yesterday was an affirmative vision for how President Trump will work to tackle families’ biggest challenges and make life more affordable.
Instead, what we got was deflection, distraction, and deception. He was more interested in finger pointing than in rolling up his sleeves. He spent more time talking about trans people than about bringing down prices. And, he lied about everything from climate change to Social Security.
To the extent there was real substance in the speech, his signature policies were imposing poorly thought-out tariffs (which will raise costs for families) and empowering Elon Musk (who is relentlessly attacking workers and recklessly dismantling our government).
We deserve leaders who actually, well, lead. That means seeing the real challenges Americans are facing, taking responsibility, and getting to work to deliver solutions.
Sadly, last night was yet another reminder that Donald Trump only looks out for himself.
––Katie

## The Must-Watch Moment From Last Night:
President Donald Trump **[gave a show-stopping surprise last night to a young man](https://substack.com/redirect/839b7306-2adb-478c-be7c-303fc3b52bd2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** who survived brain cancer, during his address to a joint session of Congress.
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/839b7306-2adb-478c-be7c-303fc3b52bd2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/839b7306-2adb-478c-be7c-303fc3b52bd2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The young man, DJ Daniel, 13, has always wanted to be a police officer, Trump explained during his speech, adding that DJ has been made an honorary officer of several police departments before. DJ was sitting next to his father, dressed in a Houston police uniform, when Trump singled him out.
"In 2018 DJ was diagnosed with brain cancer. The doctors gave him five months at most to live. That was more than six years ago," Trump said.
"Police departments love him. And tonight, DJ, we're going to do you the biggest honor of them all. I am asking our new Secret Service director, Sean Curran, to officially make you an agent of the United States Secret Service."
This amazing MAGA moment will make you cry (and yet the Democrats still did not applaud...) **[Watch it right here:](https://substack.com/redirect/839b7306-2adb-478c-be7c-303fc3b52bd2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

CNN Republican Scott Jennings **[REFUSES to be insulted by a smug Democrat](https://substack.com/redirect/6a67cace-f17c-4d15-b1f9-6e73bd2c61a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** who mocks him during a live televised debate.

"That's not actually what we said!" one democrat came back. "We said upholding the principles of the constitution in the time that we have seen..."
Jennings interrupted for clarification, "How is the President shredding the Constitution?!!"
"I mean, seriously?! Do we have to give you a civics lesson?!! We put all power in the executive branch,... the legislative branch, the FBI, now he's in control of the military, this is what you do in a dictatorship!!" another democrat fired back.
"The President is in charge of the military, is he not?" Jennings said, baffled by what he just heard.

---

Peter, We can’t secure fair maps around the country without ensuring a fair count in the census. But the census is under a multi-pronged attack, and it’s a three-alarm fire: **1\. Hours into Donald Trump’s second term, he repealed an order that affirmed how everyone in the country should be counted in the U. S. Census.** Trump’s action on the census could lead to a blatant attempt to undercount communities with higher populations of immigrants and undocumented people. **2\. Republican state attorneys general also sued to stop the 2030 Census from counting all U.S. residents.** And the federal judge presiding over this case is a Trump appointee with a track record for upholding gerrymandered maps. **3\. In recent weeks, massive Census Bureau data files that are normally publicly available disappeared from the website.** Some of those files have come back online, but this raises concerns about the integrity of this critical data now and going forward. **We’re fighting back.** Our mapping and analytics team is working hard to compile records of past census data so we can closely watch for any changes. And we know we can defend the census because the fair maps movement has protected it before — stopping Trump from adding a citizenship question in his first term. [**Our democracy is on the line. Can you please donate $30 or whatever makes sense to prevent Trump and anti-democracy extremists from rigging the system in their favor? This is a three-alarm fire, and every single contribution will go a long way to help ensure we can stop them in their tracks.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/103262359/531660372/469381263?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_ComingForCensus_email_20250305-NDRC-Tier1-ComingForCensus_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20250305-NDRC-Tier1-ComingForCensus_&utm_campaign=ComingForCensus&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjAwZTliYjFkLWNhZjktZWYxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=SiAhIA6-t1E_YfHeqCaLscJEL_SQ9E5PNKMzVUpuB64=) | _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_

Last night I gave the official response to President Trump’s Joint Address. I hope you had a chance to watch. If not, **[here's a link to it on YouTube](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/3678?t=2&akid=2251%2E135344%2ErI5C3U)**.
Since most people don't know me like you do, I introduced myself and just kept it straight with the people watching about the moment we are in right now.
We just went through another fraught election season. Americans made it clear that they want change. But there is a responsible way to make change, and a reckless way. And, we can make that change without forgetting who we are as a country, and as a democracy.
Because no matter where you live, most Americans share three core beliefs: That the middle class is the engine of our country. That strong national security protects us from harm. And that our democracy, no matter how messy, is unparalleled and worth fighting for.
We all know that our country is going through something right now. We’re not sure what the next day is going to hold, let alone the next decade.
But this isn’t the first time we’ve experienced this as a country. Every single time, we’ve gotten through those moments because of two things: Engaged citizens and principled leaders.
Every day I will fight to be the kind of principled leader the people who elected me deserve, and it's a message I hope to carry with me as I campaign for others next fall.
If you're with me in that fight, I have an ask of you:

I just finished my address to the nation! This is a message of confidence, strength, and hope.
This comes straight from the heart:
**TOGETHER, WE ARE RENEWING THE AMERICAN DREAM.**
**_WELCOME TO THE NEW GOLDEN AGE OF AMERICA!_**
I have accomplished more in one month than any President in four years!

**#1** Closed the Border and ENDED THE INVASION

Dear Connecticut State Senators,

My name is ____________ and I am a resident of the town of _____________.

I am writing this testimony in support of Senate Bill 647 concerning our utility rates and especially the public benefits charge. We are consumers of energy and it is not our job to subsidize the utility companies and their Public Benefits charge that is almost 30 percent of our bill. Connecticut should not have the 3rd highest utility rates in the country. We are not Hawaii or Alaska and this is unacceptable.
We should not be subsidizing our neighbors or businesses to make energy upgrades. That is the role of a utility company to pay for those upgrades so they do not have to provide as much electricity. if my neighbors wants solar, they can pay for it, NOT ME.
This public benefits charge does not benefit the public. We need nuclear energy and this needs to be classified as renewable - it is clean and reliable energy unlike the windmills and solar that are not. We also need to increase the supply of natural gas while we move to more nuclear. Make Connecticut an affordable state again.
I strongly SUPPORT this bill. We need affordable energy. PUT CONSUMERS FIRST AGAIN.

name: Jim Schultz
subject: Put Working Families First: Time to Cut Taxes to Protect Minnesota’s Future
body:
Higher taxes will exacerbate the reality that a significant number of Minnesotans are heading to other states. We need to make it easier to live here.

| | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/6a0ace5410ac/the-briefing-from-mpbc-12798984?e=baf210d431)
---
| | | | [](https://growthmn.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e307c9beec837f7456d65a5e6&id=f946256f98&e=baf210d431)
---
| Dear Friend,
Just two years ago, Minnesota had a historic surplus of nearly $19 billion. Yet instead of using that windfall to deliver lasting relief to the taxpayers who helped create it, DFL legislators pushed through a massive spending spree and introduced a host of new taxes. Today, our state faces a projected [**budget deficit**](https://growthmn.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e307c9beec837f7456d65a5e6&id=8698098e9d&e=baf210d431) of $5.1 billion, and working families are caught in the middle. If we fail to act, that deficit will be “fixed” by even more tax hikes, compounding the burden on Minnesotans who already pay some of the highest tax rates in the country. It’s time for our elected officials to put working families first by cutting taxes and rolling back the punitive increases that helped create this mess.
**Minnesotans Want Lower Taxes** Recent polling confirms what we already know: Minnesotans overwhelmingly want lower taxes. According to a [_**KSTP/SurveyUSA**_**poll**](https://growthmn.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e307c9beec837f7456d65a5e6&id=d2b769f9e8&e=baf210d431) , 25% of respondents named “lowering taxes” as the single most pressing issue for legislators—more than any other topic. Voters see right through the notion that Minnesota simply has a revenue problem. In reality, the issue is spending, fueled by a liberal willingness to use the record-high surplus to expand government programs rather than provide genuine tax relief.
**A Dire Competitive Climate** Not surprisingly, Minnesota ranks **44th overall** on the [**2025 State Tax Competitiveness Index**](https://growthmn.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e307c9beec837f7456d65a5e6&id=9e115ee474&e=baf210d431) , weighed down by our highly progressive income taxes, hefty sales taxes, and the nation’s second-highest corporate tax rate at 9.8%. These burdens disincentivize entrepreneurs from setting up shop in Minnesota, undercutting job creation and wage growth.
Unsurprisingly, a separate [**study**](https://growthmn.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e307c9beec837f7456d65a5e6&id=61b89f0f90&e=baf210d431) placed Minnesota **49th out of 50 states for entrepreneurs** , citing a drop in new business applications and high inflation as contributing factors. None of this should come as a surprise. When taxes rise, employers look elsewhere to invest, slowing our economic engine and making it harder for families to make ends meet.
**Tax Relief That Helps Everyone** Rather than doubling down on failed tax-and-spend policies, we must unlock Minnesota’s potential by offering substantial tax relief. Here are four immediate steps to spark our economic renewal:
1. **Eliminate the First Income Tax Bracket**

Allowing the first $50,000 of income for married filers to be tax-free (currently taxed at 5.35%) would provide working families with annual savings of up to $2,500. Over time, that’s real money back in the pockets of everyday Minnesotans who need it most.
2. **Lower the Corporate Tax Rate**

Reducing the corporate rate from 9.8% to 8.0% would move Minnesota out of the top tier of states with the highest business taxes. The result? More job openings, better wages, and a stronger economy powered by local entrepreneurship and investment.
3. **Return Future Surpluses to Taxpayers**

House Republicans have introduced a plan for a constitutional amendment that would automatically return a portion of future budget surpluses to taxpayers, preventing lawmakers from repeating the mistakes made during the $19 billion surplus bonanza.
4. **Fully Eliminate the Tax on Social Security Benefits**

It’s high time we ended Minnesota’s tax on Social Security benefits, allowing seniors to keep more of their hard-earned income and enjoy a secure retirement. Many liberal politicians promised this during campaign season—it’s time to deliver.
**A Call to Action** This is more than just a policy debate; it’s about the future of our state and the ability of everyday Minnesotans to make ends meet. Higher taxes will only exacerbate the reality that a significant number of Minnesotans are heading to other states. We need to make it easier to live, work, and raise a family in Minnesota, and one good place to start is by lowering taxes for all.

Working with you,
**Jim Schultz** PresidentMinnesota Private Business Council
**P.S.** If you believe in protecting our freedoms and safeguarding the rule of law, consider joining the fight by becoming a [**Main Street Member of the Minnesota Private Business Council**](https://growthmn.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e307c9beec837f7456d65a5e6&id=6db568f75e&e=baf210d431). Together, we can ensure that our constitutional rights endure for future generations. Membership offers numerous benefits, including:
* **Bimonthly newsletter:** Stay informed with key policy and business updates.
* **Real-time alerts:** Get timely information on critical state legislation.
* **Exclusive insights:** Access to key polling and political landscape analyses.
* **Advocacy:** Join us in advocating for the policies that will renew Minnesota’s promise.

**Cost:** $100 per year—a small investment for a significant impact.
Join us in this crucial fight for the future of Minnesota. Together, we can ensure that our state not only recovers, but thrives. Your support is vital in this mission.
[**Become a Main Street Member today**](https://growthmn.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e307c9beec837f7456d65a5e6&id=092ae1fc07&e=baf210d431).

Everyday necessities like groceries and gas are expensive. Housing costs are rising. People are picking up second jobs to help make ends meet. Donald Trump had an opportunity to directly address the American people last night and share how he planned to solve these issues. **He did none of that.** Instead, what we heard from the president were the same old attacks. He attacked Democrats for trying to hold him accountable to the Constitution and rule of law. He rambled on about diversity programs and went out of his way to discredit Social Security benefits and demonized marginalized communities. He spread falsehood after falsehood, trying his best to divide us on every issue. This type of rhetoric is not what we needed to hear from the President of the United States — but I am not surprised. clean_body: | | Friend, Last night, Donald Trump gave his first address to Congress since taking office. While the speech should have given the country an update on the state of our union, it was nothing more than lies and campaign rhetoric. Right now, Americans are reeling from rising costs. Everyday necessities like groceries and gas are expensive. Housing costs are rising. People are picking up second jobs to help make ends meet. Donald Trump had an opportunity to directly address the American people last night and share how he planned to solve these issues. He did none of that. Instead, what we heard from the president were the same old attacks. He attacked Democrats for trying to hold him accountable to the Constitution and rule of law. He rambled on about diversity programs and went out of his way to discredit Social Security benefits and demonized marginalized communities. He spread falsehood after falsehood, trying his best to divide us on every issue. This type of rhetoric is not what we needed to hear from the President of the United States — but I am not surprised. I watched Trump's 2025 Joint Session speech so you wouldn't have to--and here are the results. Donald Trump spent about half the 100 minute diatribe demonizing immigrants, and the other half rambling on everything from oil, to forcibly taking Greenland and the Panama Canal, to demonizing DEI and Trans Americans, to trying desperately to convince Americans that a trade war via tariffs would be good for our economy. At no point did Trump mention Medicaid, Abortion, or Gun Safety. His mentions of Climate Change, the Middle East, Race relations, and law and order were to poke fun at Democrats or play victim himself. Here's the breakdown and key points you'll want to be aware of. **Let 's Address This.**

## Fact Checking Trump's Disinformation SOTU
**Claim:** We've accomplished more in 43 days than most administrations have in 8 years, and we're just getting started
**Fact Check:** In reality Trump has so far signed one piece of legislation into law, the fascist inspired Laken Riley Act. More on this later. Executive Orders are not legislation and do not carry the weight of legislation. Signing EOs to dismantle regulatory agencies, fire military judges, and build concentration camps are not "accomplishments," unless you're trying to become "America's Hitler," as JD Vance once remarked.
**Claim:** Trump claimed the Presidential Election of November 5 was a "mandate like has not been seen in many decades." He added, "For the first time in modern history more Americans believe our country is headed in the right direction than in the wrong direction. A 27 point swing, the most ever."
**Fact Check:** In reality, the November 5 election was one of the closest in modern history. Moreover, no discoverable poll suggests that majority of Americans think America is headed in the right direction, and every poll I could find suggests the exact opposite. e.g. A [poll taken just this week](https://substack.com/redirect/7da2994a-0cd8-423c-9dab-8a7d0ab140d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) says 34% of Americans say America is headed in the right direction while 49% say wrong direction.
**Claim:** Trump claims "Small Biz optimism saw its biggest jump ever recorded. A 41 point jump."
**Fact Check:** In reality, The National Federal of Independent Business, which tracks small business optimism, reported to the contrary. In its January 2025 survey, NFIB holds that Small Biz Optimism fell 2.3% in January 2025.

NOTE: Speaker Johnson issued a decorum warning to Rep Al Greene of Texas, who was protesting Trump's speech. Rep Greene refused to stop protesting, so Speaker Johnson then had Rep Greene forcibly removed. Republicans chanted "na na na na hey hey hey good bye."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3281d47d-5f4a-457d-8e30-742e57c79f0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Rep Al Greene Protests Trump. Creator: J. Scott Applewhite | Credit: APCopyright: Copyright 2025 The Associated Press.
**Claim:** Many have stated that the first month of our presidency is the most successful in the history of our nation. They're saying #2 is George Washington.
**Fact Check:** In reality, nobody is saying this. Trump is making things up.
**Claim** : Trump says this despite this being his 5th speech, there is nothing he can say to Dems to make them stand or smile. "I could find a cure to disease, create greatest economy, or stop crimes, and these people will not stand for these astronomical achievements."
**Fact Check:** In reality, Trump has not actually achieved any of those things. On the contrary his incompetence led to mass death under COVID, the economy sputtered under his previous Presidency, and he did nothing to actually reduce crime. Instead, he pardoned 1600 violent white supremacist insurrectionists. A reminder that every MAGA claim is a confession.
**Claim** : Trump claims America is better now because he:
1. Terminated the "Green new Scam,"
2. Withdrew from Paris Climate Accord that apparently cost us Trillions of dollars.
3. Withdrew from corrupt WHO.
4. Withdrew from UN Human Rights council.
5. Ended Biden's environmental restrictions because they were unaffordable and made us less safe.
6. Ended EV mandate, saving our workers from economic destruction.

**Fact Check:** In reality:
1. The Green New Deal was never law, and if it was, he couldn't terminate it by EO.
2. The Paris Climate Accords did not cost us Trillions of dollars and Trump has zero evidence to back up this claim.
3. Withdrawing health regulations is what enabled COVID to spread quicker than it would have otherwise.
4. We're well aware that Trump does not value human rights.
5. Trump provides zero examples of how climate justice makes us less safe. On the contrary [climate justice better secures human rights](https://substack.com/redirect/e8a1f13d-d556-4344-9b87-6c53cd4b6ac9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
6. Studies [already prove](https://substack.com/redirect/3847054b-a754-4c7a-bda8-7568aaf9d48a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the EV mandate both helped the climate and boosted sales for automakers.

**Claim:** Trump brags that under his administration, for every 1 new regulation, 10 old regulations must be eliminated, and doing so will "unshackle our economy."
**Fact Check:** In reality, the only thing this deregulation will "unshackle" is safety. [As I've written before](https://substack.com/redirect/a1ca1849-0f59-490f-8c35-1b8203136204?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), studies show that Trump's absurd deregulation strategy resulted in the FAA admitting they were prevented from passing critical safety regulations, that could have prevented airline accidents. In fact, I've written in detail on how [Republican deregulation has resulted in the collapse of numerous industries](https://substack.com/redirect/a1ca1849-0f59-490f-8c35-1b8203136204?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and sadly, it is expected to happen again now.
**Claim** : Trump claims he has stopped all government censorship and brought back free speech in America.
**Fact Check:** In reality, Trump has done the opposite. He has banned even discussing DEI under penalty of termination. He has criminalized peaceful protest, literally yesterday tweeting this nonsensical tirade:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/debb2908-96a7-40a2-a941-80137e465b1b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Apparently, Nazis wearing Camp Auschwitz shirts, beating cops to death, and smearing feces on the halls of Congress = Free Speech and Full Pardon, while students peacefully protesting genocide of Palestinians funded by US tax dollars = Illegal Agitators. For Trump, "free speech" is anything that advances white supremacy, even violently, and illegal speech is anything that demands justice, even peacefully.
**Claim:** Trump says English is now the official language of the United States because he signed an EO making English the official language of the USA.
**Fact Check:** In reality, an Executive Order does not undo legislation. The Supreme Court and HHS have already interpreted Title VI of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 and Section 1557 of the Affordable Care Act--both of which prohibit discrimination on the basis of "national origin"--to include language. The irony of course is that Trump's grandfather, a criminal undocumented immigrant who arrived in 1917, himself could not speak English when he arrived. So if Trump's EO was actual law throughout American history, the Trump family may never have been welcomed on America's shores.
**Finding value in this article so far? Join the movement and become a paid subscriber.**
[ Upgrade to paid](https://substack..P0Mr09QCBrF4AKarDc-CTejSIy2At3EGoElVRWAr8WE?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=158402545)
**Claim:** Trump claims that he "ended the tyranny of DEI policies all across the entire government and military and private sector. Our country will be 'woke no longer." He adds, "We believe you should be hired on skill and competence, not race and gender. You should be hired based on merit."
**Fact Check:** [As I've already written in detail](https://substack.com/redirect/3d61529e-02aa-424c-a8af-66cb29ec365e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), DEI is literally merit based hiring, and if Trump actually cared about meritocracy, he would abolish Legacy admissions, which near exclusively benefits unqualified white applicants.
**Claim:** We have removed the poison of CRT from public schools.
**Fact Check:**[As I've already documented](https://substack.com/redirect/cb9f2b82-daa0-4d5c-9656-bd31df4bfd0d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), public schools never taught Critical Race Theory. A reminder that words like "woke," "DEI," and "CRT" are all used because modern white supremacists find that easier to say than the N-word to discriminate against Black people.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0ae602b8-2964-4fa2-9e32-7faf02025322?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Claim:** We have made it policy that there are only two genders, male and female, and signed an EO banning men from playing in women's sports, and will cut federal funding to any school who does not comply.
**Fact Check:** Trump is announcing he doesn't believe in science. As a baseline, about 1.7% of people are bornIntersex. The science [tells us that](https://substack.com/redirect/aacb9d7b-2d55-44e6-98ba-bf12e96068d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), "Intersex people are born with sex characteristics (such as sexual anatomy, reproductive organs, hormonal patterns and/or chromosomal patterns) that do not fit typical binary notions of male or female bodies." Trump called it "demeaning to women," to allow trans athletes to compete, which is especially offensive given more women have accused him of sexual assault (27) than there are trans athletes (10) among 500,000+ college athletes. It's also offensive given Trump's repeal of DEI and Affirmative Action will do far more to harm tens of millions of women than any ban on trans athletes could ever "help" women. This is another culture war Trump will continue to cite to elevate violence and hate against Trans people, while distracting from his own failed policies as he bankrupts our nation and the working class.
**Claim:** Trump alleged his:
1. "top priority is to rescue our economy" and claimed "We inherited an economic catastrophe and an inflation nightmare." He added "America suffered the worst inflation in the history of our country under Biden," who also let the prices of eggs get out of control. Trump plans to "defeat inflation by reducing the cost of energy."
2. He alleged Biden cut new oil leases by 95%, closed 100 power plants, and that Trump is reopening those power plants. Trump also claims that his administration will drill for oil in our own country.
3. He alleged that Japan and South Korea want to invest "trillions" of dollars into an Alaska natural gas pipeline.

**Fact Check:** In reality,
1. The average year-over-year inflation under Biden was [4.95%](https://substack.com/redirect/cafd0cb7-c438-4f7e-9727-73a37abb1dae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which was still the lowest among developed nations globally in the post-COVID inflation era. As far as U.S. history, Nixon had 6.01%, Ford had 8.11%, and Carter had 9.85%. The Bureau of Labor Statistics reports that the highest inflation in US History was in 1917 at 20.17% and in 1778 at 29.78%. By the way, Trump's inflation of 2.46% was a full percent higher than Obama's inflation of 1.46%. Also, eggs are higher priced now than they were under Trump, largely due to the spreading bird flu, which Trump has done absolutely nothing to address.
2. Biden actually approved more onshore drilling than did Trump, a fact that many on the left are still bitter about. The fact that Trump is attacking Biden on this anyway should be another wake up call to Democrats to stop trying to appease Republicans, and start trying to do what's right and what your base wants.
3. [Japanese officials have made clear](https://substack.com/redirect/7cbe21b8-5820-4754-ba16-11e25dcb47b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) they have _not_ agreed to participate in the pipeline, let alone invest "trillions" of dollars.

**Claim:** Trump claims he "Created DOGE to end flagrant waste of taxpayer dollars." Then after praising Elon musk, he cited alleged waste. The list is too long to dive into here, but suffice it to say, DOGE has provided zero actual evidence of waste. I'll point to just three examples of Trump's lies here. Trump claims DOGE found as waste:
1. $22B from HHS to provide free housing and cars for illegal aliens.
2. $45M for DEI scholarships in Burma
3. $8M for making mice transgender.

**Fact Check:** None of the above is a typo, the President of the United States Actually said this. All in all Trump estimates annual fraud of over $500B in our nation--which might actually be true if we audited the Pentagon, but that isn't something Trump is willing to do. In reality:
1. This claim originates from the right wing tabloid, the Murdoch owned NY Post, which itself cites a right wing blogger's opinion. There's zero actual evidence backing up this claim from any independent or non-partisan watch dog org.
2. This is part of Trump shutting down USAID. The $45M were funds committed to help 400 students from lower income backgrounds get access to education and opportunities otherwise deemed impossible. None of this is actual waste, but it is incredibly cruel to promise, then deny students the opportunity to learn.
3. I was unable to find any actual evidence of this, nor has Trump offered any actual evidence of this, but I suspect the actual story is more than what's been offered without evidence.

Suffice it to say, the rest of Trump's reckless evidenceless claims follow this protocol--make a claim, don't offer evidence, require blind acceptance. He does love the poorly educated, after all.
**Claim:** Trump alleges "probable fraud in our Social Security program" with his "evidence" a long list of tens of millions of Americans allegedly well over 100 years old getting, some even more than 200 years old.
**Fact Check:** I'll even be so bold as [to quote Fox News](https://substack.com/redirect/44c5d154-495f-40ef-b9cc-53d0827c42fd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to show how truly unhinged Trump is on this lie:
> In 2015, the [SSA and its inspector general ](https://substack.com/redirect/57ee1e76-42f5-4d2e-b9db-095528e3eb52?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)looked into the number of people in the system with no death record who were listed as being over the age of 112. SSA found 6.5 million number holders aged 112 or older with no death information in the system, **but noted that other records suggested the majority of them were deceased**. Of those, SSA issued payments to 266 number holders -- though the IG's review indicated only 13 beneficiaries were likely age 112 or older, while in the remaining 253 cases there were discrepancies in SSA's records that indicated the beneficiary wasn't actually that old.
So not only did Trump lie, he lied so badly that he even lost Fox News, and yet worse, he's tried to fire the Inspector General who is responsible to prevent waste, fraud, and abuse at the Social Security Administration.
**Claim:** Trump claims he's going to balance the federal budget for the first time in 24 years.
**Fact Check** : In 2017 Trump claimed he's eliminate the debt in 4 years, and instead added more to the national debt than any President in American history. This time will likely be no different, especially considering his planned $4.5T tax giveaway to billionaires.

Let us maintain hope in each other, in our Republic, and in the promise that we can form a more perfect Union by upholding justice above all else. My commitment over these next four years and beyond will be to continue to advocate for absolute justice in my writing and actions, sharing factual and honest analysis of the human rights issues that impact us all. I cannot do this alone, and am grateful for your support. You can see the amount of time and research it took to write this piece. I am going to shoot straight with you.
According to the 'very smart consultants' in DC, our Democratic campaign in the special election Florida's 6th Congressional district has already lost this election. They say:

* The district is too red and that Trump/MAGA are too powerful, triumphant, and near omnipresent.
* The narrow pathway to retaking the House via winning the three special elections in 2025 is impossible. Democrat's only shot of retaking the house is in 2026.
* It would take a literal miracle for us to win here.

When Democrats don't try we lose. Despite what the institutional losers in DC say (yes the same ones who played a decisive role in our 2024 loss) this race is beyond winnable.
Seeing is believing, and over the past two and a half months, I have seen with my very eyes the rise and rapid scaling of a campaign that could win this.
In these past two months we've raised over $7.3 million (what most representatives raise in a two year cycle), have recruited tens of thousands of volunteers in district and from all fifty states, have hired a team of over a hundred paid staff the majority being canvassers who are knocking over 10,000 doors a day.
Even if they were right that a literal miracle would be required to win, I believe we are on the cusp of one.
Miracles are happening every day for us. Just last Friday we were more than $53k off from our vital end of month target, donations were rapidly slowing down, and less than three hours remained on the clock. Not hitting our target and being unable to pay out our massive payroll.

Team, Last night, I attended Donald Trump’s first speech to a joint session of Congress since he resumed office. I _hoped_ that he would propose real solutions to improve the lives of hardworking Americans — but unfortunately, we heard more empty promises and partisan rhetoric. The President tried to suggest that America is back and better than ever. But his actions paint a different picture. You can’t say you love farmers when you are disrupting their markets and financial livelihoods with misguided tariffs. You can’t talk about helping children with cancer when you gut the NIH and end clinical trials. You can’t honor our military when you dismantle veterans’ services and fire veterans working across federal departments. You can’t champion children with disabilities when you want to abolish the Department of Education. You can’t support the police when you pardon January 6th criminals who attacked law enforcement. body:
| If Republicans cut Medicaid, it’s real Wisconsinites who they’re hurting.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=4612%2E35263%2E-cqnVq)
Peter — Last night, I attended President Trump’s joint address to Congress. I’ll share my thoughts with you in a moment, but first, I want to talk to you about my guest to Trump's address. Because when we talk about cuts to Medicaid, Medicare, and Social Security, we cannot forget the everyday people who suffer due to this administration’s actions. Last night, I was joined by a constituent from Milwaukee, a cancer patient who relies on Medicaid for her treatment. When I first spoke with her over the phone, she voiced how terrified the possible cuts to Medicaid made her. Let me be clear: No one should have to consider bankruptcy to continue receiving lifesaving care, but that is the reality that many Wisconsinites and their families face due to the threat of President Trump’s cuts. If Republicans cut Medicaid, it will be seniors, vulnerable children, and our neighbors and family members who pay the price. Last night, we saw more of the same from Donald Trump. Hi everyone. Senator Elissa Slotkin here.

Last night I gave the official response to President Trump’s Joint Address. I hope you had a chance to watch.

Since I’m a stranger to most people who don’t follow politics, I introduced myself and just kept it straight with the people watching about the moment we are in right now.

We just went through another fraught election season. Americans made it clear that they want change. But there is a responsible way to make change, and a reckless way. And, we can make that change without forgetting who we are as a country, and as a democracy.

Because no matter where you live, most Americans share three core beliefs: That the middle class is the engine of our country. That strong national security protects us from harm. And that our democracy, no matter how messy, is unparalleled and worth fighting for.

We all know that our country is going through something right now. We’re not sure what the next day is going to hold, let alone the next decade.

But this isn’t the first time we’ve experienced this as a country. Every single time, we’ve gotten through those moments because of two things: Engaged citizens and principled leaders.

If you're with me in that fight, I have an ask of you:

clean_body: Last night I gave the official response to Trump’s speech - here's what I said. | = Hi everyone. Senator Elissa Slotkin here. Last night I gave the official response to President Trump’s Joint Address. I hope you had a chance to watch. Since I’m a stranger to most people who don’t follow politics, I introduced myself and just kept it straight with the people watching about the moment we are in right now. We just went through another fraught election season. Americans made it clear that they want change. But there is a responsible way to make change, and a reckless way. And, we can make that change without forgetting who we are as a country, and as a democracy. Because no matter where you live, most Americans share three core beliefs: That the middle class is the engine of our country. That strong national security protects us from harm. And that our democracy, no matter how messy, is unparalleled and worth fighting for. We all know that our country is going through something right now. We’re not sure what the next day is going to hold, let alone the next decade. But this isn’t the first time we’ve experienced this as a country. Every single time, we’ve gotten through those moments because of two things: Engaged citizens and principled leaders. **The Truth About The Coming Food Crisis**
---
---
**This might be your only warning.** According to official reports, dangerous global events have reached America, putting the entire nation in harm's way. Despite this imminent crisis, mainstream media remains silent... And our own government ignores dire warnings of industry experts like fourth-generation American farmers who warn: **_“Food shortages are coming.”_** Imagine the panic of seeing empty grocery store shelves, not for a few days, but for several weeks or even months. The loss will be beyond what you can imagine. **As a result of this crisis, survival food is more important than ever.** If you don't take action or if you stockpile the wrong foods, you could be setting your family up to go hungry in a time of crisis. It sounds harsh, but the truth is too many people with good intentions are making critical mistakes with their survival food. Mistakes like...
* Getting MREs with a 5-year shelf life – depending on where you purchase them from they could be near expired...
* Getting gross survival foods that are tough to stomach and so high in salt, MSG and preservatives you could clog your arteries and get yourself sick...
* Or simply getting the wrong foods and leaving a critical hole in your meal plan, which means you risk becoming malnourished...

**Well, no need to worry anymore.** Obviously, waiting for the government to give me a handout in a disaster just wasn't an option for me. And I was completely turned off by the crazy high cost of survival food sold by some companies. That's why I ordered and got my very own stockpile of these best-selling [**Survival Food Kits**](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/20559/6374453/bb6536c5860cc404561708a2d2ec9d80772e2d2f/19c75af6fee0a5c3d7bf7e5e5a9ef4351bbc3133). When you secure your own food stockpile, you will have the peace of mind and security knowing that when a crisis hits... You will be able to calmly reassure your family that they're safe and they will have plenty to eat. [**Click here to secure your own stockpile of these best-selling survival food kits while you still can.**](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/20559/6374453/bb6536c5860cc404561708a2d2ec9d80772e2d2f/19c75af6fee0a5c3d7bf7e5e5a9ef4351bbc3133) When a crisis hits, the masses begin to panic, and grocery stores are wiped out. It quickly becomes every man for himself. Don't make the mistake of waiting until it is too late. [**Stock up now**](https://links.gunowner-news.com/a/1537/click/20559/6374453/bb6536c5860cc404561708a2d2ec9d80772e2d2f/19c75af6fee0a5c3d7bf7e5e5a9ef4351bbc3133) on these survival food kits while you can. **More Raving Customer Reviews!** **Rory H.**
"I was surprised to find that the densely packed packages were easy to prepare and were tasty as well. I definitely recommend having survival food on hand for the times when 'life' happens while we are planning other things." **Billy H.**
"Received my food kit, and I was able to make the potato soup on my cookstove. Just needed boiling water. Gave it a good stir and let it simmer. When I opened up the pot, it smelled so good. You can see the chunks of potatoes and carrots in each bite you take. It's a good soup." **Kevin S.**
"The 72 hour kit is a perfect starter kit for any scenario. Put one in your car, work bag, in your house or RV. If you want to start preparing safe food, this is where to start." **Carol B.**
"I have been iced in this weekend. I thought I would try my potato soup. To my utter delight, IT WAS DELICIOUS. Thank you for such a wonderful product and the peace of mind it brings." **Ken K.**
"I am not a full-blown survivalist. I am not an idiot, either. I have been through enough in my life and have seen friends who have been through an emergency situation. Save up if you have to, but get at least a month's supply. It tastes good. Although if it's a dire of an emergency, you will be happy to eat anything. IF you have something to eat for your family. We made some of this product, and had family and friends over for them to taste. They all agreed they didn't think anything would be this good, and they will be ordering. Just do something. You can't miss out on this deal." **Justin A.**
"My wife and I tried the food and we were both surprised about how good it tasted and how satisfied it made us feel afterwards. It feels good knowing that I can provide for my family if a crisis arose and I intend to get more in the future. Also the shipping and customer service has been top notch. This is probably the cheapest survival food I have found, and the company is great." **Gary M.**
"I actually had lost my job and was homeless for a while. I dug into my food supply, and I cannot fully describe how delicious and easy to prepare everything is. I felt like I was eating like a king. I am going to stock up again as soon as I settle into my new job. Everyone should participate with this company. You will not be disappointed." **John H.**
"We're in Florida and have made many preparations for the aftermath of a possible hurricane. While we are thankful that Florida has not been hit in several years, it gives us great peace of mind to know we have our 4Patriots kit stashed away, knowing it's not a case of "if" but "when"." #### **RC Maxwell Joins Frozen Odds as Featured Expert**
**We’re excited to announce that RC Maxwell, a fearless journalist and advocate against Ranked Choice Voting (RCV), will be featured in Frozen Odds, a groundbreaking documentary on Alaska’s citizen-led fight to repeal RCV.****RC Maxwell has an incredible story to tell. Years ago, he exposed Sen. Lisa Murkowski’s ties to RCV, helping reveal the system’s deeper implications. His investigative work with Project Veritas, with James O’Keefe, played a key role in spreading awareness about the dangers of RCV. He has since continued his work with at Newsmax, even interviewing me last year as we battled RCV in Alaska.****Personally, RC Maxwell was pivotal in my journey to challenge RCV. His early reporting helped shape my understanding of the issue, ultimately leading me to write the repeal and lead the grassroots movement against RCV in Alaska. Over the years, I’ve had the privilege of meeting him at CPAC and in Arizona, where I was educating others on the dangers of RCV.****We are honored to have RC Maxwell join us in filming Frozen Odds this summer. His firsthand experience and relentless commitment to election integrity will bring critical insights to this documentary.****Stay tuned—Frozen Odds is coming soon to uncover the truth behind Alaska’s fight for fair elections!**
---
#### **ANNOUNCEMENT: Captain Seth Keshel and Dr. Chris Mattmann Join Frozen Odds Movie as Featured Experts**
**We’re honored to announce that Seth Keshel, MBA, will be featured in Frozen Odds, the powerful documentary on Alaska’s citizen-led fight against Ranked Choice Voting (RCV).****Seth Keshel is a former Army Captain of Military Intelligence and Afghanistan veteran. His analytical method of election forecasting and analytics is known worldwide, and he has been commended by President Donald J. Trump for his work in the field. He most recently made headlines by correctly forecasting a 312-226 Trump victory in the Electoral College, with accurate picks in all 56 races for electoral votes.****Captain Keshel proposes 10 Points to True Election Integrity and has identified Ranked Choice Voting as one of the eight cardinal sins of election administration. He toured Alaska in the spring of 2022 while fighting the information battle associated with promoting election integrity.****In Frozen Odds, Captain Keshel will bring his expert analysis and firsthand experience to expose the flaws of RCV and its impact on election integrity.****Dr. Chris Mattmann Joins Frozen Odds as Featured Expert****We’re thrilled to announce that Dr. Chris Mattmann, a leading AI and data expert, will be featured in Frozen Odds, a powerful documentary on Alaska’s citizen-led fight against Ranked Choice Voting (RCV).****Dr. Mattmann’s career is nothing short of extraordinary. He is the Chief Data and AI Officer at UCLA, former Chief Technology and Innovation Officer at NASA JPL, and President of Mattmann.ai. An accomplished author and industry leader, he has played key roles in advancing AI, big data, and technology across multiple fields.****With firsthand experience in RCV from his time at the Apache Software Foundation, Dr. Mattmann will break down its flaws in Frozen Odds, sharing his expert insights and concerns based on real-world applications.****Stay tuned—Frozen Odds is coming soon to reveal the truth behind Alaska’s fight for fair elections.**

**Starting a film project for Amazon Prime, YouTube, etc. – Frozen Odds How do you take on $15 million with nothing but determination, grassroots organizing, and a clipboard? Frozen Odds is a gripping documentary that uncovers the raw power of citizen-led initiatives in Alaska. Following the journey of a small but determined movement, this film reveals how everyday people—outspent 100 to 1 by out-of-state interests—rallied together to challenge the system. Led by an Alaskans for Alaskans who helped write the law and push it to the ballot, this battle wasn’t just about policy—it was about democracy in its purest form. With 400+ volunteers braving the cold, gathering 42,000 signatures when only 26,000 were needed, they proved that people—not money—should shape the laws that govern them. Through intimate interviews, on-the-ground footage, and stunning Alaskan landscapes, Frozen Odds captures the high-stakes struggle against political elites (aka Lisa Murkowski and George Soros, etc.) and the enduring spirit of grassroots activism. Though the campaign fell just 700 votes short out of 320,000, it laid the groundwork for a new wave of initiatives—this time, with three fresh petitions ready to take the fight forward. In a world where billionaires and lobbyists try to control the political process, Frozen Odds asks a bold question: What happens when ordinary citizens refuse to back down?**

I asked pro-Ukrainian protesters in Washington D.C. **[one simple question](https://substack.com/redirect/42b5428f-d23f-4d23-9828-d9686a86b71b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** yesterday, and the complete non-answers I received should probably disturb you if you are an American taxpayer.
"How much more money does the U.S. need to send to you guys?" I asked one protester from Ukraine who was wrapped in a blue and yellow flag.
"As much as it takes to win..." she answered.
[Watch The Video](https://substack.com/redirect/42b5428f-d23f-4d23-9828-d9686a86b71b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/42b5428f-d23f-4d23-9828-d9686a86b71b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"So is that an infinite amount of money?!" I needed clarification, and was stunned by her answer. I was also stunned when she started lecturing me, an American taxpayer and financier of the defense of her homeland, about my "hypocrisy" for "victim blaming" Ukraine.
"What kind of message are you sending to other countries, to this dictatorship?!" she snapped at me.
Again, I was taken aback by **[the accusation instead of even one word of gratitude](https://substack.com/redirect/42b5428f-d23f-4d23-9828-d9686a86b71b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for the $170 billion we already gave her. I told her my concern, "Look, I feel bad for you guys, I just need to know how much more this is going to cost me..."
I was immediately interrupted by a mask-wearing karen who called me a troll and ruined my interview. You need to learn to roll with the punches at these protests, interruptions, name calling (with spit sometimes), and attempts at physical intimidation are all what you're signing up for when all you want to do is ask a simple and fair question.
[Watch The Video](https://substack.com/redirect/42b5428f-d23f-4d23-9828-d9686a86b71b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The encounter remained me of Zelensky's attitude of entitlement when speaking with President Trump in the Oval Office. Lecturing, figure pointing and baseless "or elses."
**[Another protester revealed to me he just retired from the IRS,](https://substack.com/redirect/42b5428f-d23f-4d23-9828-d9686a86b71b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** where he was hard at work everyday collecting tax dollars from working Americans and business owners. Unsurprisingly to me, he supported unlimited funding from the U.S. to Ukraine, until Putin was defeated.
"You're an IRS agent and you support sending infinite tax dollars to Ukraine?! Do you see the irony with that at least?" I asked him, flabbergasted.
Even when presented with President Zelensky's own words, admitting he lost track of $100 billion in aid sent by the U.S., protesters refused to say U.S. aid should be stopped until that money is located.
The entire scene was chaos and absurdity, which is pretty normal for these protests in D.C., and I eventually realized I wasn't going to get the answer I was looking for from these people.
Is it too much to ask, if you support sending tax dollars to a cause, any cause, can you tell me in round numbers exactly how much it will cost? Is that reasonable? Apparently not.
[Watch The Video](https://substack.com/redirect/42b5428f-d23f-4d23-9828-d9686a86b71b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

name: Douglas Carswell
subject: Delbert Hosemann kills School Choice
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/deathbydelbert?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Dear Friend, **Mississippi is surrounded by states that empower parents with School Choice.** Arkansas, Alabama, Tennessee, and Louisiana all allow families to choose the schools that best fit their children’s needs.

President Donald Trump, the most pro-School Choice president in history, recently urged every state to adopt policies that give parents this fundamental right.

**_Yet yesterday, Delbert Hosemann killed a bill, HB1435, that would have allowed public to public School Choice._**
---
|
---
_Mississippi misses because Mr Hosemann killed School Choice bill HB1435_
| Previously, however, Mr Hosemann had publicly implied support for public to public school choice. What changed?

Perhaps when implying support, Mr Hosemann never really had any intention of supporting the bill? Maybe he thought he could imply support, but then quietly kill the bill and hope no one would notice?

Well, you’ve noticed. The more than 80,000 recipients of this email across Mississippi will notice. And the tens of thousands of families wondering what their “conservative” Senate leader actually stands for will notice too.

**Speaker Jason White, a steadfast advocate for School Choice, put it best in response to this news: “At some point, your actions have to match your words. You can’t keep saying you’re for something and continue to kill it.” **Well said.

There’s still a glimmer of hope. Representative Jansen Owen, another heroic champion for parental rights, has taken the bold step of incorporating the text of HB1435 into another bill.

**School Choice could still pass—but only if enough Mississippians recognize what’s been happening at the Capitol this past week, where Senate leadership has undermined sound conservative policy.**

We need your voice now more than ever. Help us spread the word and hold our leaders accountable. Together, we can fight for the future our children deserve.

clean_body: | | | | | | Dear Friend, Mississippi is surrounded by states that empower parents with School Choice. Arkansas, Alabama, Tennessee, and Louisiana all allow families to choose the schools that best fit their children’s needs. President Donald Trump, the most pro-School Choice president in history, recently urged every state to adopt policies that give parents this fundamental right. Yet yesterday, Delbert Hosemann killed a bill, HB1435, that would have allowed public to public School Choice. | Mississippi misses because Mr Hosemann killed School Choice bill HB1435 | Previously, however, Mr Hosemann had publicly implied support for public to public school choice. What changed? Perhaps when implying support, Mr Hosemann never really had any intention of supporting the bill? Maybe he thought he could imply support, but then quietly kill the bill and hope no one would notice? Well, you’ve noticed. The more than 80,000 recipients of this email across Mississippi will notice. And the tens of thousands of families wondering what their “conservative” Senate leader actually stands for will notice too. Speaker Jason White, a steadfast advocate for School Choice, put it best in response to this news: “At some point, your actions have to match your words. You can’t keep saying you’re for something and continue to kill it.” Well said. There’s still a glimmer of hope. Representative Jansen Owen, another heroic champion for parental rights, has taken the bold step of incorporating the text of HB1435 into another bill. School Choice could still pass—but only if enough Mississippians recognize what’s been happening at the Capitol this past week, where Senate leadership has undermined sound conservative policy. We need your voice now more than ever. Help us spread the word and hold our leaders accountable. Together, we can fight for the future our children deserve. | "Forward this email to a friend!" | | Warm regards, Douglas Carswell President & CEO | | |

I’m Paige Spence, OLCV’s Board chair. I’ve been involved with OLCV’s work for many years: I joined the board in 2019, and served on staff as OLCV’s Coalition Director before that. I’m proud of the hard work that OLCV does every day to keep Oregon healthy. It’s no secret that Oregon’s environment is increasingly threatened, endangering our homes, health, and unique quality of life. Sound environmental policies at the state and local levels are necessary for us to safeguard the health of our families and secure the future of our state. This work isn’t easy, but the many and ever-increasing climate threats we’re facing require us to engage in these policy decisions. That’s where OLCV’s Board of Directors come into place. OLCV plays an important role in keeping Oregon green, while our boards work together to guide the organization and ensure fiscal responsibility. Our board works in all corners of Oregon to ensure equitable environmental outcomes for all Oregonians. If you’re ready to work with Oregon communities to bring about change and have skills to share with our movement, we encourage you to apply! A strong candidate for our board would have a passion for advancing pro-environmental policies and climate justice and are ready to collaborate in fundraising efforts. OLCV is committed to [justice, diversity and inclusion](https://click.everyaction.com/k/103294758/531732524/1762832227?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQzMzVlYjc0LWU3ZjktZWYxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=LtFZvJjufb2b_XjnfTxFDwjpCF1JtXZHOl_vS_HwYnQ=&emci=e4a65eb5-4af9-ef11-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=d335eb74-e7f9-ef11-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=2107230), both in our organization and outwards, so our Board Members are expected to share in our commitment to equity and justice. disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Massachusetts Democratic State Committee
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93809/images/Logo.png]
Dear Peter,
Over the weekend, the New York Times released a powerful interview with Governor Healey that laid out her plans to stand up for Massachusetts against Trump, Musk, and their destructive intentions for our democracy.
Governor Healey knows this ball game. As our Attorney General during Trump’s first term, she led the charge against so many of his illegal activities, and she’s used to the tactics he uses to try and distract the public from them. Just recently, Trump publicly confronted Maine Governor Janet Mills for following the laws of her state- and Governor Healey knows he’s doing this to “distract everyone from the fact that [his] poll numbers are tanking, people don’t like what Elon Musk and DOGE are doing”.
Our Governor won’t let Trump distract her from always acting in the interest of the people of Massachusetts. Here’s some more important messages from her interview:
* Governor Healey made it clear that though she’s wary of the actions the Trump administration has taken so far, her first priority will always be the wellbeing of our state; “If the president is going to work and support the state of Massachusetts, I will work with the president and the federal administration. When he is not, then I will be the first to stand up and fight for the people of Massachusetts”.
* While Trump, Musk, and their cronies make backdoor deals that only benefit their wealthy buddies, Democrats will continue to be the party of the working class: “As Democrats, our North Star needs to be standing up for everyday Americans”.
* She also spoke extensively about being motivated to work on behalf of all of us: "I became governor because I care about people. I want to serve people. I want to see the people in Massachusetts served. My colleagues I have the privilege of working with, the Democratic governors, believe in America, believe in the needs, the wants of everyday Americans".
We’ve always known that our Commonwealth has a powerful fighter in Governor Healey. We’re proud to have her as our voice on the national stage, taking the GOP to task at every turn.
We’ll be tuning in this Wednesday to see her on Late Night with Seth Meyers!
You can read the full interview at this link. [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/03/01/magazine/maura-healey-interview.html?smid=url-share]
Click here to read Governor Healey's NYT Interview! [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/03/01/magazine/maura-healey-interview.html?smid=url-share]
Onward,

name: Gov. Tony Evers
subject: About last night’s speech…
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tony for Wisconsin
body:
[ ](https://go.tonyevers.com/go/2648?t=3&akid=7084%2E1827488%2EByEhsJ) | Derek,

I’d like to take a minute to talk about Donald Trump’s address to Congress, the state of our country, and ****[why I’m asking you to pitch in to support my work as governor of Wisconsin.](https://go.tonyevers.com/go/2645?t=6&akid=7084%2E1827488%2EByEhsJ)****

Last night, we heard Donald Trump talk a lot about what divides us.

We heard him sow hate at the immigrants who help make this country great, who contribute to our economy and our communities. We heard him attack the public servants who get up every day and go to work to get things done and make government work for us.

Donald Trump claims that he’s doing this in order to make the government more efficient, and in order to cut taxes. In some ways, those are goals we share. But while I’ve worked to cut taxes for the middle class and those who need it most, under Donald Trump’s tax plan, the folks who will benefit the most are the ultra-wealthy. And while my administration has focused on making government work smarter and faster and making sure it works better for you, he’s cutting essential workers who work on Social Security, take care of veterans, and support our recovery from national disasters.

I’ve said it before: We cannot allow reckless decisions in Washington to stop our momentum, and we cannot allow anyone’s determination to sow hatred to divide us. I believe – and I have always believed – that there is more that unites us than divides us, and that our Wisconsin values of kindness, empathy, compassion, and respect will do more to take us forward as a country than anything.

As I said in my State of the State address, my promise to the people of Wisconsin has always been to be a governor who works for all Wisconsinites, who does the right thing when it matters most. That’s not what we saw on display at the U.S. Capitol this week, but it’s what I will continue to do in order to keep fighting for progress.

****[So today, I’m asking you to join me in fighting for that progress, and in building a state and a country where we create a better future together. If you can, chip in $5, $10, or whatever you’re able.](https://go.tonyevers.com/go/2645?t=7&akid=7084%2E1827488%2EByEhsJ)****

Onward, Tony Evers

body:
Donald Trump might try to bully us, but we will not give up.
# [](https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/203?t=1&akid=136%2E181023%2EUpFALK)
Team,
Last night, Donald Trump delivered his first address to Congress since being re-elected. It was exactly what we expected.
Celebrating tariffs on our allies in Canada and Mexico, which will raise prices for Michiganders. Cutting millions of dollars in federal funding for our state. Spreading lies about voter fraud, reproductive freedom, and marginalized communities.
During the campaign, Trump said his top priority would be to lower prices. That’s not what’s happening.
Instead, this speech shows that he and Elon Musk are only focused on petty revenge.
This rhetoric isn’t new.
In 2020, President Trump suggested that I should be arrested for treason and executed for refusing to overturn Michigan’s election results for him. I refused to back down from his attacks.
Luckily, Michigan women have always led the way in standing up to bullies like Donald Trump, including last night.
Senator Elissa Slotkin delivered the Democratic response to Trump’s speech, and the difference was night and day. She focused on issues that Michiganders _actually_ care about, like how to deliver for our veterans, our students, our union workers, and our families.
**Donald Trump might try to bully us, but we will not give up. We will fight back harder than ever to stop his extreme agenda and put Michiganders first.**
[**I am running to become Michigan’s next Governor, but I can’t do it without you. Election experts rank this as a toss-up race, and Republicans are going to spend big to flip this seat red. Will you rush in $10 to help me stand up against the incoming attacks and fight for a stronger Michigan?](https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/269?c0=jmb-em-q12025.KUgwrp&refcode=AU_JMB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20250305_PM1_V1_S1&t=2&akid=136%2E181023%2EUpFALK)**

name: Gretchen Whitmer
subject: Here in Michigan, we lift people up — not tear them down.

body:
That's how we get things done. |
#
---
Team, As Michigan’s 49th Governor, I couldn’t be more proud of all the work we’ve done to focus on the important issues, protect our fundamental freedoms, deliver real results for working families, and **make Michigan the best place in the country to live, work, and raise a family.** Here in Michigan, we lead with our values. We put in a hard day’s work, treat one another with respect, and move forward together. We lift people up, not tear them down. That's how we get things done. But the truth is we have a lot more work to do to build on everything we’ve accomplished together and create the future we know is possible. That’s why, just last week, I outlined my vision for Michigan in 2025 during my State of the State address. Last night I gave the official response to Trump’s speech - here's what I said.

| Hi everyone. Senator Elissa Slotkin here.

Last night I gave the official response to President Trump’s Joint Address. I hope you had a chance to watch.

Since I’m a stranger to most people who don’t follow politics, I introduced myself and just kept it straight with the people watching about the moment we are in right now.

We just went through another fraught election season. Americans made it clear that they want change. But there is a responsible way to make change, and a reckless way. And, we can make that change without forgetting who we are as a country, and as a democracy.

Because no matter where you live, most Americans share three core beliefs: That the middle class is the engine of our country. That strong national security protects us from harm. And that our democracy, no matter how messy, is unparalleled and worth fighting for.

We all know that our country is going through something right now. We’re not sure what the next day is going to hold, let alone the next decade.

But this isn’t the first time we’ve experienced this as a country. Every single time, we’ve gotten through those moments because of two things: Engaged citizens and principled leaders.

Senator Elissa Slotkin here.

Last night I gave the official response to President Trump's Joint Address. I hope you had a chance to watch.

Since I'm a stranger to most people who don't follow politics, I introduced myself and just kept it straight with the people watching about the moment we are in right now.

We just went through another fraught election season. Americans made it clear that they want change. But there is a responsible way to make change, and a reckless way. And, we can make that change without forgetting who we are as a country, and as a democracy.

Because no matter where you live, most Americans share three core beliefs: That the middle class is the engine of our country. That strong national security protects us from harm. And that our democracy, no matter how messy, is unparalleled and worth fighting for.

We all know that our country is going through something right now. We're not sure what the next day is going to hold, let alone the next decade.

But this isn't the first time we've experienced this as a country. Every single time, we've gotten through those moments because of two things: Engaged citizens and principled leaders.

If you're with me in that fight, I have an ask of you:

| MassGOP Slams Mayor Wu's Sanctuary City Secrecy: No Data, No Accountability, No Answers
---
---
| WASHINGTON, D.C. - Today, Mayor Michelle Wu joined a panel of progressive mayors testifying before the House Oversight Committee in defense of their sanctuary city policies. Unlike her counterparts, Mayor Wu was unable to provide basic data on how many illegal immigrants have entered Boston over the past four years or how much taxpayer money is being spent on individuals who are in the country unlawfully.
MassGOP Chair Amy Carnevale blasted Wu's lack of transparency, calling it a betrayal of Boston's hardworking taxpayers.
"Mayor Wu's refusal to disclose the financial burden her policies place on Boston residents is unacceptable," said Carnevale. "Taxpayers deserve to know how much of their money is being diverted away from vital services from lifelong Bostonians to fund sanctuary city policies that encourage illegal immigration. Instead, Wu admitted that the city doesn't even track how much is being spent on illegal immigrants."
During her testimony, Mayor Wu conceded that Boston does not ask about immigration status when distributing city resources. Carnevale called this a reckless approach that prevents residents from knowing how their tax dollars are allocated.
"It is clear that a significant portion of Boston's public resources could be going to illegal immigrants rather than longtime residents of Roxbury, Dorchester, and other struggling communities," Carnevale continued. "Mayor Wu's policy not to ask about legal status suggests either gross mismanagement or a deliberate attempt to shield the public from the truth."
Wu has repeatedly claimed that her sanctuary policies make Boston safer--a claim that collapses under the weight of reality. Carnevale pointed to the case of Wiseteguens Jean Quely Charles, a Haitian illegal immigrant and known member of a violent street gang, who racked up 17 criminal convictions, including multiple drug, weapons, and assault offenses. Protected by sanctuary policies, Charles remained in Boston, shielded from deportation--until ICE agents stepped in to remove him from the streets.
"How can Mayor Wu continue to insist that these policies make Boston safer when they are the very reason criminals like Charles are drawn to our city in the first place?" Carnevale said. "It is only thanks to the brave men and women of ICE that a dangerous gang member was finally removed. Wu's policies don't protect Bostonians--they put them at risk."
Adding to the outrage, the City of Boston spent $650,000 preparing Mayor Wu for her testimony--raising further concerns about how much has already been spent trying to obscure the full financial impact of her policies.
"This is willful negligence," said Carnevale. "If Wu's administration doesn't even know how much taxpayer money is being funneled towards illegal immigrants, how can they claim to be acting in the best interests of Boston residents? It's time for transparency and accountability--not more excuses."
Boston taxpayers deserve answers. The MassGOP will continue fighting for the truth and exposing the consequences of failed sanctuary city policies.

Guy is joining us for Baumtoberfest in two weeks!

| | | | | Friends,
Rep. Guy Reschenthaler is the Chief Deputy Whip, a key leader responsible for lining up the critical votes to pass the Republican agenda in the House. At just 41 years old, the military veteran and attorney is a rising star being watched by pundits as a possible future Speaker of the House.
_**We are honored that Guy will be joining us for Baumtoberfest in just two weeks!**_
You saw Guy in action last week when the House – with only one vote to spare – passed “one big beautiful” budget bill outlining tax cuts and spending reductions.
These are historic times for our nation: with unified government we are taking unprecedented steps to secure the border, to stop the federal overspending, and to restore common sense to America. Guy is at the center of the action and decision-making in Congress. **Join us for this special opportunity to hear directly from him about what's happening behind the scenes in leadership.**
Guy is a native of Pennsylvania and represents the rural area near Pittsburgh. After graduating from Penn State and law school, he joined the Navy during the Iraq War from 2008 to 2012.
Like Michael Baumgartner, he didn’t waste much time after returning home to run and win a seat in the State Senate, defeating a Democratic incumbent in 2015. In 2018 he was first elected to Congress, winning reelections in 2020, 2022, and 2024.
Growing up in Pittsburgh, Guy probably attended his share of Oktoberfests, but this will be his first Baumtoberfest! We’ll be watching to see if the Chief Deputy Whip wears lederhosen. [You can RSVP by clicking here.](https://hotmail.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=91b93e6889137ccb3f3fef037&id=e36a8205c5&e=5a45b9550e)

Hi everyone. Senator Elissa Slotkin here.
Last night I gave the official response to President Trump’s Joint Address. I hope you had a chance to watch.
Since I’m a stranger to most people who don’t follow politics, I introduced myself and just kept it straight with the people watching about the moment we are in right now.
We just went through another fraught election season. Americans made it clear that they want change. But there is a responsible way to make change, and a reckless way. And, we can make that change without forgetting who we are as a country, and as a democracy.
Because no matter where you live, most Americans share three core beliefs: That the middle class is the engine of our country. That strong national security protects us from harm. And that our democracy, no matter how messy, is unparalleled and worth fighting for.
We all know that our country is going through something right now. We’re not sure what the next day is going to hold, let alone the next decade.
But this isn’t the first time we’ve experienced this as a country. Every single time, we’ve gotten through those moments because of two things: Engaged citizens and principled leaders.
If you're with me in that fight, I have an ask of you:
