| Dear Congressman Al Green,

I am writing to express my deep disappointment and outrage at your shameful behavior during the State of the Nation. Your decision to interrupt this sacred institution was a slap in the face to the millions of Americans who voted to put America First once again.

Your actions were a stark reminder of the disrespect and contempt that many Democrats have for our country and its institutions. It's unacceptable that you would use this moment to grandstand and score cheap political points.

I demand that you apologize to the American people for your boorish behavior. Your actions were not only a disservice to the office of the President, but also to the country as a whole.

Furthermore, I call on your colleagues in the Democratic Party to condemn your actions and take steps to ensure that such disrespect is not tolerated in the future.

Make no mistake, Congressman, the American people will not forget your behavior. We will remember your lack of respect and decorum, and we will hold you accountable for your actions.

The America First movement will not be deterred by your attempts to disrupt and undermine our efforts. We will continue to stand strong and united in support of our values and our country.

Sincerely,

Peter, Donald Trump’s address to Congress last night confirmed what we already knew: **His top priority is to use the powers of the presidency for his own personal benefit — not to help working families across the country.** While he emboldens Elon Musk — the richest man in the world — to cut essential programs the American people rely on, eggs are 15.2% more expensive, gas is up 1.8%, and health care for 72 million Americans is on the chopping block. **We need leaders in Congress who are willing to stand up for our Constitution and the rule of law and defend the American people from Trump’s lawlessness.** That’s why I recently sat down for an interview with _The Hill_ to discuss the path forward in a second Trump term and my work to hold him accountable. What he _hasn’t_ done is take any meaningful action to fulfill his promises on the campaign to lower costs for hardworking Americans. In fact, he’s done the complete opposite. For example: 1) He undid Democrats’ successful efforts to lower prescription drug prices. 2) He has increased inflation and implemented massive tariffs against our closest trading partners, which will only raise the cost of goods for the American people. 3) And he has directed House Republicans to pass a bill that would give billionaires like Elon Musk and himself a _massive_ tax break that can only be paid for by slashing at least **$600 billion** in Medicaid spending. **In other words, Trump is coming after your health care to line his own pockets.** Trump’s lawlessness knows no ends, Peter. He has broken his oath to the Constitution on multiple occasions, and he’s already broken his promises to the American people. For example: 1) He undid Democrats’ successful efforts to lower prescription drug prices. 2) He has increased inflation and implemented massive tariffs against our closest trading partners, which will only raise the cost of goods for the American people. 3) And he has directed House Republicans to pass a bill that would give billionaires like Elon Musk and himself a massive tax break that can only be paid for by slashing at least $600 billion in Medicaid spending. In other words, Trump is coming after your health care to line his own pockets. Trump’s lawlessness knows no ends, Peter. He has broken his oath to the Constitution on multiple occasions, and he’s already broken his promises to the American people. Hi Peter, It’s Governor Katie Hobbs and, if you have a moment, I’d love to tell you a bit about my story and how this little girl from Tempe went on to become the 24th Governor of Arizona. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/103308520/531763513/-315898513?refcode=AU_KMH_EG_WEL_PET_NTL_20250305_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZjE4ODc1My1mYWY5LWVmMTEtOTBjZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BqDEbSqm9tkfpiDYctB1dm6_q1XoWgdCJ1I43RhMlXY=&emci=30816a63-19f9-ef11-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=6f188753-faf9-ef11-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=38724247) As a young girl growing up in Tempe, my family struggled. Sometimes we had to rely on food stamps or members of our church community just to make ends meet. My parents taught me the value of a dollar and the dignity of hard work, and it was through my faith that I first got into public service as a volunteer at my church. After putting myself through college and graduate school, I began working as a social worker in Phoenix. Every day, I saw so many hard-working families like mine struggling to get by, pay their medical bills, and provide for their kids. Arizonans were paying the price for the failures of our elected officials — and I was fed up. **I knew that to change our government, we needed to change the people working within it. So I decided to run for office, and I haven’t lost an election since.** I have grassroots supporters like you to thank for that. In 2022, we won one of the most closely-watched, toss-up gubernatorial races in the country, defeating MAGA conspiracy theorist Kari Lake and electing Arizona’s first Democratic governor in over 15 years. Ever since I took office, I’ve been hard at work addressing the very real challenges Arizonans are facing day in and day out. Meanwhile, extremist Republicans are trying to thwart my efforts with divisive chaos and unnecessary culture wars rather than address the issues affecting our daily lives – and frankly, it doesn’t have to be this way. **[I know we can make Arizona the best place to live, work, and raise a family, and I am counting on you, Peter, to join our team as we push for real bipartisan progress and solutions. clean_body: | = I’d love to tell you a bit about my story. Katie Hobbs is the Governor of Arizona, and is getting to work to make our government work for the people of our state. We’re counting on supporters like you to help power this campaign. If you would no longer like to hear from us, you can or opt for fewer emails by clicking Hi Peter, It’s Governor Katie Hobbs and, if you have a moment, I’d love to tell you a bit about my story and how this little girl from Tempe went on to become the 24th Governor of Arizona. As a young girl growing up in Tempe, my family struggled. Sometimes we had to rely on food stamps or members of our church community just to make ends meet. My parents taught me the value of a dollar and the dignity of hard work, and it was through my faith that I first got into public service as a volunteer at my church. After putting myself through college and graduate school, I began working as a social worker in Phoenix. Every day, I saw so many hard-working families like mine struggling to get by, pay their medical bills, and provide for their kids. Arizonans were paying the price for the failures of our elected officials — and I was fed up. I knew that to change our government, we needed to change the people working within it. So I decided to run for office, and I haven’t lost an election since. I have grassroots supporters like you to thank for that. In 2022, we won one of the most closely-watched, toss-up gubernatorial races in the country, defeating MAGA conspiracy theorist Kari Lake and electing Arizona’s first Democratic governor in over 15 years. Ever since I took office, I’ve been hard at work addressing the very real challenges Arizonans are facing day in and day out. Meanwhile, extremist Republicans are trying to thwart my efforts with divisive chaos and unnecessary culture wars rather than address the issues affecting our daily lives – and frankly, it doesn’t have to be this way. | As Governor, I am doing everything in my power to build an Arizona that works for everyone, but the fact of the matter is, I can’t do this work alone. If you’re ready to rebuild and strengthen our economy, restore women’s reproductive rights, make life-saving investments in health care, invest in our schools, our teachers, and the next generation of Arizona leaders, solve our state’s water crisis, and so much more, Thank you for reading, and I’ll be in touch with more soon, Katie P.S. This picture was taken the day before I was sworn in as the 24th Governor of Arizona. You've seen the wins stacking up at the national level, right?
Well, brace yourself--because it's hitting hard at the state level now too.
Because in YET ANOTHER WIN, [my bill to smash lawfare and shield Idahoans from being crushed in court or bankrupted by deep-pocketed elites and organizations](https://substack.com/redirect/738ca0a6-0311-4090-97fa-e91a3d41108b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) just cleared the House **UNANIMOUSLY** and is barreling toward the Governor's desk!
_This is a massive win for Idaho._
As one of only 15 states without an Anti-SLAPP statute, this bill's passage locks in First Amendment protections for Idahoans who dare to speak out, join public debates, and flex their constitutional rights.
Check out my debate on it here:
[](https://substack.com/redirect/af486bc4-acd4-4d6e-9117-09d2502688d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Watch Representative [Rep. Heather Scott](https://open.substack.com/users/174110853-rep-heather-scott?utm_source=mentions)'s debate on it here:
[](https://substack.com/redirect/cbd577df-82ee-497e-817c-703a44b8b3e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I pushed the same bill last year (2024), only for it to get slaughtered on the Senate floor--thanks to #politics (i.e. "they" couldn't stomach handing me a fat win in an election year when they were already out for my blood).
**Here 's what happened the first time:**
[](https://substack.com/redirect/19ac15e9-e0ac-4947-b218-911aff1635f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**But this year, the New Golden Age is upon us and there was no stopping it.**
This is a damn good day for Idaho.
So much winning--and we're just warming up.

Hi everyone. Senator Elissa Slotkin here.
Last night I gave the official response to President Trump’s Joint Address. I hope you had a chance to watch.
Since I’m a stranger to most people who don’t follow politics, I introduced myself and just kept it straight with the people watching about the moment we are in right now.
We just went through another fraught election season. Americans made it clear that they want change. But there is a responsible way to make change, and a reckless way. And, we can make that change without forgetting who we are as a country, and as a democracy.
Because no matter where you live, most Americans share three core beliefs: That the middle class is the engine of our country. That strong national security protects us from harm. And that our democracy, no matter how messy, is unparalleled and worth fighting for.
We all know that our country is going through something right now. We’re not sure what the next day is going to hold, let alone the next decade.
But this isn’t the first time we’ve experienced this as a country. Every single time, we’ve gotten through those moments because of two things: Engaged citizens and principled leaders.
If you're with me in that fight, I have an ask of you:

name: Matt Diemer
subject: Checking in after a long break
body:
| |
---
Hey everyone, Sorry I’ve been MIA lately. After running for four years straight, I needed some time to decompress. As exhausted as everyone is with the news cycles, political cycles, and everything we keep up with, I’m just as tired—maybe even more. So, I’ve been taking some time to recharge and get motivated again. But I wanted to send this email to let you know I’m still here and still paying attention. Even though I’m not actively out there engaging right now, I’m here in spirit. That said, I’ve been getting a lot of messages about senators and congressmen simply not showing up. They’re not answering calls, they’re not returning messages, and they’re not holding town halls—at a time when people have serious questions that need answers. That is not what they were elected to do. One of the main reasons I ran for Congress is because I believe Congress is broken. Too many representatives don’t actually serve the people—they serve big interests, billionaires, lobbyists, super PACs, and every special interest you can name. I wanted to be there for you. Whether you liked me or not, agreed with me or not, I was always going to show up, answer questions, and explain what was going on—because representing the people of Ohio’s 7th District was my priority. Right now, representation is more crucial than ever. We can’t just sit back and hope things turn out the way we want. We must demand that our representatives show up, answer questions, and communicate with the people they were elected to serve. I think it’s more important than ever to go back to [DiemerForCongress.com](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.yjJN_MEbNx94PLaWzZ6hW7JqI14UcNKmqsa0iyGKPFGsnaX3tgXeezt4kK6bW6AqGP6he4IEl2vhirvgcwau1rKogukAAARZGhOVJR-KQOrEYf3YPp02iWpYpHqmGdhW-iR2cNqx2dU8UbjIlkc6J8vgAs9D9rWhr1dg7_dWu1nkN0WW7IBqXB0uc6gErCLf3V3tZRAy4sDHxb_FzqiBguSfV3GWOqaP_YaSJJ829S2249P6EhwgOzXeMFzfo6iaaXOMFq8-FdQfEr_AT3YUuQ/4ej/cSlvwA1jQDKIgmOj622D3A/h0/h001.sXQVCOQDj0uj_df0WIRJpyBFc5D4O5knSZM06i6hm9I) and take another look at our platform. The undemocratic way our elected officials operate—putting money over politics, profit over people, and the powerful few over the hardworking backbone of this country—is more apparent than ever. We need a complete overhaul of campaign finance and a fundamental restructuring of how influence is wielded in Washington, D.C., and in our statehouses. If that doesn’t happen, I fear we’ll continue sliding into an era where the Gilded Age looks like a utopia of equality by comparison. Finally, please stay optimistic and keep looking toward the future—because the next elections are our opportunity to create real change. Feel free to reach out and let me know what’s on your mind. I’d love to hear from you—your ideas, your thoughts on current events, and your suggestions for our district and for me moving forward. Talk soon,
Matt
---

name: Mark Kelly
subject: I sat through Trump’s speech so you don’t have to. Here’s what happened:
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
Trump covered a lot of ground, and he got almost all of it wrong.
#

Team, I sat through Trump’s speech so you don’t have to. Here’s what happened:
Trump covered a lot of ground — and he got almost all of it wrong.
Trump said America’s momentum is back. Tell that to the people depending on Social Security to pay the bills.
He said the American dream is surging like never before. Tell that to the next generation of Americans: young people who think they might never be able to afford their own home.
He said he’s working hard to bring prices down — and, _what_? What is his administration doing (seriously) to lower prices? Everything they’ve done is driving prices _up_. His pointless tariffs and trade wars are raising costs for families, and he’s going after health care and food assistance for seniors and people who already struggle to make ends meet.
He’s attacking the CHIPS Act, which kicked off hundreds of billions of dollars in private investment, created thousands of jobs in Republican and Democratic states alike, and reinvigorated American manufacturing.
Donald Trump won the presidential election last year, and I accept that. But he won by telling the American people that his top priority was going to be lowering costs. I don’t think anyone, if they’re looking at this in good faith, would say that priority number one for this administration is making things more affordable for working families and the middle class. It’s closer to the opposite.
It’s just not serious. So, I’ve got two goals over the next two years:
First, to force the Trump Administration to back off of the harm it is inflicting and defend the American people whenever and however I can — and take actions that will _actually_ lower costs. Second, to elect the next generation of leaders in the House, the Senate, and here in Arizona.
To accomplish each of those I’m going to need a lot of help. So, if I can count on you, please:

Dear Friend,

I recommend you take a little time to start our free online course...

**[Totalitarian Novels](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/s/c/439Qk4pLL40hV0-b-xilghyATCwjpBhullvZNAfXUkz8UyuVLowzXSTyyXd045pbt44O35HJnPeTT8id-eNXjFCRCHNHVU71scmngT8-xurtfgDGknBC7pChV-s041LZW7M-j5e7znvsbej37QPeRJ1y2BcdnC_kpuj_BqJa_1_7VTAqre3dAWTsfSEKkebZzECHSlRUxlnIwI6iXwRhTFUeuijcW5y31dnbcxNrjC_dDkKOpRriuSd7QXNAzkct98MhwqTRKktQ5jYfSlFzK5hfuKtuE4w-EDoDbkRYvEH_dJxFKvDk1T9D5qx_XT-RNrVXMBU_7IttGyvXkprimq-R8G9EN-P9x3m49IGkozJ8sXO6UfDEMP5-L8Y1nDzyvXk5r7X3xUn1hnmBOe5OfkZBHBn9aoNZ48QxaVAIz392j629os5dXv_iWfPQ7-p0ivscXKSW9MUYD4m1gEY/mWfXuFTilML1p5U3S_Vxj1HQFCeg30w-/6).**

You'll be able to learn from my boss--and Hillsdale College President--Larry P. Arnn as he teaches this course through [four novels: George Orwell's _1984_ , Aldous Huxley's _Brave New World_ , Arthur Koestler's _Darkness at Noon_ , and C.S. Lewis's _That Hideous Strength_ (my personal favorite of these four)](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/s/c/Swu9hs5rNHPbknvGXsQHKwRPja92VQxVWJOl50-C32J0wRlA1H7ysPYHviXazQSMcS8UDuXd-Mf98bokrMtkXmVenSYFjwjB0u85K74ZFd9iBmrrIIJQwpm7qNT0LcxKc4_WxGCu5WK8MIu5O3GIC0FB7F6Ez3bncva70cCK2LtplUQqbqYMtT7SsJuZPz-8wktcpF_kEtKttlGhFpMvwme_Op2dV-L5Zn1nUYOQfS7PDjjL8RqExAmvUE2cz2GKdYkQiGqeC483SMhS0-puFPPYo-kwST76CU658klj-gqZV1d6VqEXOd-m5qDq5qRQAgCiE8IfV26RADBvasaXekd3UOjMbBZvhKxeYVFva_e81LuVjGcGDDVf89a8fQEEw3apX_sLNAPuhE43IaQb1TOY1cMAnMJbGe-_rAtJBlQqCdAbeYtX5SHFY_OPY4I88xvG-nnj_wlliOVNAw8/M02WtEByTFYj77HHSBEFAZQUh9YRtD43/6).

**You 'll find the worlds of these novels are eerily familiar...**

* Endless wars, a surveillance state, and the distortion of history and truth by the media define not only Oceania--the dystopian world of _1984_ --but also contemporary America.
* The drugged and pleasure-obsessed inhabitants of _Brave New World_ reflect a troubling reality in modern America, where addictions to alcohol, fentanyl, pornography, food, gambling, and even social media are on the rise.
* A country stages a show trial for a political figure who fails to conform to ideological orthodoxy--a theme central to _Darkness at Noon_ and a striking parallel to the events of the past several years in American politics.
* If you've heard experts throw around the phrase "Trust the science," you may recognize the bureaucratic despotism of N.I.C.E. (National Institute of Co-ordinated Experiments) in _That Hideous Strength_.

We're at a turning point in our nation's history. After decades of far-Left despotism, the American people have said, "ENOUGH!"

**And that means --we can stop the totalitarian trends and ideologies in our country before they are entirely and utterly irreversible. **

I saw a T-shirt one of our Hillsdale students was sporting this fall, with the clever slogan, "Make 1984 fiction again!" I don't know about you, but I wholeheartedly agree with that sentiment.

That's why we need you to make this course available to as many Americans as possible. It will be one of the most important ways you can recognize the far-Left's totalitarian tendencies.

**[You can do that by supporting"Totalitarian Novels" after you sign-up for the free course today](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/s/c/6zw3sSa-BclG2IA-4A2g4PhDbt0wFpaSNb3RquDA--cEACka8qj9i0mRFDnOVx3RxYllMicfFTbNM_F3uGu8DK02mb1k7B39_UnepIEG2SdCJbInazKRjQbzmpEm5EQlLgcpiayO3QyVQ-xv8QxGyBu9R6cmdpiUh6aQ7EJGe-2BDZbgrEQUgavxzrljoXaavaTb7_fx9jv393tkKsZNrwV4b_8-GVPbJtcX3MHBjxLyh7Xiyn0d2Lx8ApBAnhOotRA_hPZfgh1i7GbAhrg65XXiqfPHqlkOKlVEPRgoEytqTJ4ZSHu2WI1xP9EayxNqePwbY44KCCwthXw6rWET_CFzZ-bHn6PcIRTH5FR3wqN6BSZodcnqb2DXR6cWd6En2DEgB6AleK_jyy8Ep0Y7nApWW4reVCe151RCDhKNYJBywHUM91_ZocVM8huCnCcVa1FIRq3suELT1WTdz8c/nIZK5ae5Es9wPtWYk5C66pQl020rN9jx/6).**

>> For your gift of $100 or more, you will receive a video boxset of "Totalitarian Novels" from Hillsdale College. It's one small way we can say "thank you" for your support of our educational outreach.

Your support will help promote this course and sign up as many people--especially young people!--as possible. And you will help us continue to expand our educational outreach even further.

The more people who understand the nature of totalitarianism, the less likely it will gain a foothold in America.

**Will you join us in helping promote this free online course?** You can click on the secure link below to sign up for the course and make your tax-deductible gift:

[**https://online.hillsdale.edu/courses/register/totalitarian-novels**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/s/c/4x6JQcnp_td06ozrepXzG40ViFjfpS1FMN7JUAfQGnhqai4UV7Za3v0cT1P0cGv6sHNBrTFD9Rn7L0-h1mkz8508winpc4fmKiDB22fL05-LaBXL1fjsm76LGlRGMyeYjzz-dnax8ZzSlcOk94Wprzg4fJjqnMHMufbAoPL_lQtbEwDNNc2WvNZz7S_FTG-bJRSnUZxRkyhqcgJssVxgDQsDeEfDYyYC8ID2s2yn5CKrG1Gz9jallhMz3-6DouRaO_I09PaHi37zOIkibJ1EV-5ByGmz_2RirluNO9NXca8KdoL4coUoKCyrXD8WWk0oOC9XfpDGdHrJyu1i2k-xi7kg0t10xurAixBUi2D1989VukRHABQj0xGyaYnSphYlsjSHJ8zMnw-X5_Kz3Gb31Q8ByXM_OIpWN2sr-bi_wMBV622xRyD64gTn5ClCROFJEUtZQonMKddgCxWzF3s/77AC3sjCh_gV4SSwJdw9EyWl6sSE7P9i/6)

Whatever your gift is, the most important thing is that I hear back from you right away so that we can promote this course far and wide, especially to our youth.

As our country reverses course AWAY from totalitarianism, Hillsdale's "Totalitarian Novels" free online course is more urgent than ever. Bill Gray, '01

subject: House Republicans keep attacking Nellie
body:
They're gearing up to spend millions to unseat her.

| |
---
Team, There is no disputing who Nellie works for — she works for New Jersey families and she's fighting to lower costs and create high-paying jobs. She's fighting to protect our healthcare and women's reproductive rights. **Contact:** Gage Hoekstra, Press Secretary, **[ghoekstra@indiana.gop](mailto:greid@indiana.gop "greid@indiana.gop")**

**Indiana GOP Responds To President Trump’s Address To Congress** **INDIANAPOLIS** – The Indiana Republican Party responds to President Donald Trump’s 2025 address to the joint session of Congress:

**“Under President Donald J. Trump, our country has never been stronger. In less than 45 days, he has already taken significant steps to reduce the size of government, secure our border, and implement economic policies that benefit hardworking Hoosiers****. ****For example, President Trump’s America First agenda has led Honda to manufacture its next generation of Civic hybrids in Indiana instead of Mexico—a major win for our state’s economy and workforce****,” **said Indiana Republican Chairwoman Lana Keesling.** “****After four years of Joe Biden, the United States is back, and that’s because of President Trump’s bold leadership.”**
**"President Trump consistently delivers on his promises to the American people. In 6 weeks, President Trump reduced border crossings down 90 percent; took real steps to unleash domestic energy; cut waste, fraud, and abuse through DOGE; and removed harmful DEI practices in government,”** said Indiana Governor Mike Braun. **“These are all initiatives that my administration has tackled head-on in Indiana as well, and I look forward to working with President Trump to continue doing the work that Hoosiers and Americans overwhelmingly elected us to accomplish.”** ###

clean_body: Contact your representatives now Last night, Donald Trump delivered an address to Congress that showed just how out of touch he is with everyday Americans. Trump has claimed he would lower costs for working people and families — but that’s a lie. Instead, he is continuing to push drastic cuts to Medicaid, which would gut life-saving health care for care workers, seniors, people with disabilities, and millions of children. Cutting Medicaid is not only stealing from the American people. It will worsen the care crisis. **** Under the Trump administration and a Republican-led Congress, vital programs that keep us alive and healthy are being pulled out from underneath us. At the joint address, we put care front and center — where it belongs. A Care in Action member and dedicated care worker stood proudly as a special guest alongside Rep. Nikema Williams, a powerful reminder that care is not just important — it’s essential. Together, Alicia and Rep. Williams sent a clear and urgent message: it's time to prioritize care, support our caregivers, and take action for a future where care is valued and protected. In solidarity, Care in Action

subject: First, we countered drag queens in libraries. Now our next battle needs you!
body:
Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children. | | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friend in Faith, Please -- for the sake of all our families -- take it from me as someone who's lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life...You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace. But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue's Clues_...
---
[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=d7fd8e5b1f3b4055a5357f46a446f85a&_e=7ZA6uYlDS-dEsd-qK5RKUyHdBgkXr04Ve9xion8RKb1D_gkpVnL9NSYOxHtgS4pPtDeVsj0yoJL0kbyvMRi3tr5ZZlkb_t_SysL1pDX9I0jGmxvflYWXlTr1YedTvXLOcDj4XfL54VBC7pNaJDlYr9Gf5gqBvfc-IAOijqQ_nIbdLnCUiQ-ZPYx-uVluQcNU4A3nfQ9nQQ12MtjW2h1346Fl_qxHe7bgbnDo_8ncbzW4PWLFHCj-M2EG_Dgu5-cmp3Mrm_nNxYo9L012wsFaJ4XJHAo4n552zg-ZX754qCB5OrJkrOaBG-N09FigC9EUtmiEarkTBF_slYXrmO9J3TXzvMMhtaLYSwuNKwppm5piAVprxUuG802eh1aKkymY4KT7uV2COAYjbrcUuBtHAQ%3D%3D)
---
| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to "educate" YOU about your "old-fashioned" and "mean" ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. [**Today, I'm inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great**.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=d7fd8e5b1f3b4055a5357f46a446f85a&_e=7ZA6uYlDS-dEsd-qK5RKUyHdBgkXr04Ve9xion8RKb1D_gkpVnL9NSYOxHtgS4pPtDeVsj0yoJL0kbyvMRi3tr5ZZlkb_t_SysL1pDX9I0jGmxvflYWXlTr1YedTvXLOcDj4XfL54VBC7pNaJDlYr9Gf5gqBvfc-IAOijqQ_nIbdLnCUiQ-ZPYx-uVluQcNU4A3nfQ9nQQ12MtjW2h1346Fl_qxHe7bgbnDo_8ncbzUInRT5UAOWyC4cv-ImIhFtAfGzQCLsV3AyXXxwfW6DhAS_NQvMfvBuKE8Du30IvJdlv5dpEA-_DYTT4uD46Ksi-pso5mjliHpJxst9ifA4bGKuV6zQcmA5CjIYZBtJ0ohEujOT_Pee17-dRGAd55fcyrRkxypO_YzVhnUimophhg%3D%3D)Introducing: _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.I'm making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at **Brave Books**.If you've seen me and **Brave Books** on _Fox News_ , you know we've already countered those awful "Drag Queen Story Hours" the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries. Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic "Story Hours" of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It's encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we're working to have that same impact in television.
---
>>Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth.Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart.>> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we've already completed the first ten character-building episodes of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_!We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces.And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages.It was quite a moment for everyone -- including folks just like you -- who worked so hard to get us that far.But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.
---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_
---
You see, we're making the first 5 episodes of Season 1 of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE to everyone on YouTube. That's the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging.But no one will see it if we can't get the word out. And the left will try to bury _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 -- and we need to raise the funds in this first quarter of 2025.
---
_**#2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $125,000 per episode.**_
---
I know that's a lot of money but it's actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously, we won't work through Hollywood.Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children.We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens _must take over_ to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. **[That's why I'm asking you to please contribute $35, $50, $250, $500, $2,500 or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $250,000 for advertising and $125,000 per episode for Season 2.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=d7fd8e5b1f3b4055a5357f46a446f85a&_e=7ZA6uYlDS-dEsd-qK5RKUyHdBgkXr04Ve9xion8RKb1D_gkpVnL9NSYOxHtgS4pPtDeVsj0yoJL0kbyvMRi3tr5ZZlkb_t_SysL1pDX9I0jGmxvflYWXlTr1YedTvXLOcDj4XfL54VBC7pNaJDlYr9Gf5gqBvfc-IAOijqQ_nIbdLnCUiQ-ZPYx-uVluQcNU4A3nfQ9nQQ12MtjW2h1346Fl_qxHe7bgbnDo_8ncbzUvuxnDSP5Ym9SnqEii3du5ML7NzCx4MiGFJ6luIS9ic_PMxATWCWiVJPLKektJhM8AEE8oPWds7IKJtP2ZTPyle4LYiLExDVfrFTkipIscW5mWt3t7zvbReWdJL13n7pVcdgBkUCZ6w9XoUOFVDbBY4qoOPwepWTavC5-nAxqvvA%3D%3D) ** As our special "Thank You" for becoming a **Founding Supporter** at the $50 level, we'll send you all ten episodes of Season 1 of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ _FREE on DVD_.This exclusive _Adventure with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ DVD is only offered to **Founding Supporters**. It won't be available for sale anywhere. So with **[**your gift of $50**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=d7fd8e5b1f3b4055a5357f46a446f85a&_e=7ZA6uYlDS-dEsd-qK5RKUyHdBgkXr04Ve9xion8RKb1D_gkpVnL9NSYOxHtgS4pPtDeVsj0yoJL0kbyvMRi3tr5ZZlkb_t_SysL1pDX9I0jGmxvflYWXlTr1YedTvXLOcDj4XfL54VBC7pNaJDlYr9Gf5gqBvfc-IAOijqQ_nIbdLnCUiQ-ZPYx-uVluQcNU4A3nfQ9nQQ12MtjW2h1346Fl_qxHe7bgbnDo_8ncbzXl1ZVkfjBSi-H4xo3foThstBzcqEkRLINvcKLWl-7FpoIoikHsI0izmFnpXoWLQC44Qr18E4F-2rJ5JvYUw42Qq3G4C0_bcEInIb1E0tIfSFJ3Xy3opNztmolX51NYP0wjynqWZSlXSSbSJj7cnopSLpUXH6Eke246v40dRvN5UA%3D%3D)** , you'll be part of a select group of people who own our wholesome TV show on DVD. You'll have it ready to watch with the children in your life. Or you can drop your DVD by your local school, church, mission, or even leave it in the waiting room at your doctor's office. So many children have no way of hearing God's message in their lives. Your random act of kindness may change a child's life. **[**So please -- whether you can send $50, $5,000, $25,000, or anything higher or lower, please respond quickly and know that gifts of EVERY size are needed and greatly appreciated.**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=d7fd8e5b1f3b4055a5357f46a446f85a&_e=7ZA6uYlDS-dEsd-qK5RKUyHdBgkXr04Ve9xion8RKb1D_gkpVnL9NSYOxHtgS4pPtDeVsj0yoJL0kbyvMRi3tr5ZZlkb_t_SysL1pDX9I0jGmxvflYWXlTr1YedTvXLOcDj4XfL54VBC7pNaJDlYr9Gf5gqBvfc-IAOijqQ_nIbdLnCUiQ-ZPYx-uVluQcNU4A3nfQ9nQQ12MtjW2h1346Fl_qxHe7bgbnDo_8ncbzXFmkTh5t_bVRBHZMXFtxd0dDy_vabkQ_HDNSWQ-yw5ic29Wfx4Y4g7X7GRQqSVETUliOgqkWohZTxWBGGOqNfSzOq9kz8BGCLX_OEGBLdDHHk6Ob9fYX4TbFBVsF69Cr4VrECyntlMV-D6hzS4cU8jLEpf_wHPQxoExOIp0nGTDg%3D%3D)** There's no time to waste. Hollywood groomers have destroyed America's Godly culture. But today we rebuild from the ashes.And it starts by ensuring the most innocent among us are filled with faith and family -- not filth.Thank you for being a part of history by becoming a **Founding Supporter** of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.

Race grifters and hustlers make _millions_ perpetuating DEI lies, including...

* America is a nation built on slavery, not freedom.
* All racial disparities are indisputable evidence of systemic racism--and if you question this conclusion, you must be a racist.
* Students in K-12 schools can be divided into oppressors and oppressed based on their skin color.

DEI policies have infected almost every aspect of American life, from K-12 schools to college admissions and job applications. They have even spread into the hard sciences and the military.

These policies endanger lives and, ultimately, Western Civilization itself.

I'm sure, like a lot of Americans, you want to know what you can do to stop DEI. One of the most fundamental steps is ...

**Countering the far-Left ideologies that are being taught to students in K-12 schools, colleges, and universities.**

Hillsdale College, where I am president, is engaged in a nationwide fight on the battlefield of education to save young Americans from this anti-American agenda.

Since our founding in 1844, we have offered "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty."

To do this work well, we need a clear understanding of **what informed Americans like you think about DEI and how best to fight it.**

So please share your views by completing the **DEFEAT DEI SURVEY** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time.

Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept any government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations.

**We remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities have rejected their founding statements and embraced radical and dangerous ideologies.**

Larry P. Arnn

As has been the case for over 200 years, the Electoral College determined the outcome of the U.S. presidential race last year. Yet most Americans have long supported moving away from this system. **More than six-in-ten Americans (63%) would instead prefer to see the winner of the presidential election be the person who wins the most votes nationally.** Roughly a third (35%) favor retaining the Electoral College system, according to a Pew Research Center survey of 9,720 adults conducted last fall. We're clearly all tired of a system where all our candidates and their campaigns care about is whether the margin of victory is close enough in the state to make it worthwhile to campaign there instead of speaking to real Americans with real challenges. **[The people who tell you we can't get rid of the Electoral College are wrong. subject: Donald Trump wants to fire 83,000 VA staff

body:
What this administration is doing isn’t about efficiency or improving care. It is about turning the VA into UnitedHealth — deny, defend, depose, all to maximize shareholder value. Trump and Elon have made that perfectly clear.
#
Peter, many of you rely on the VA.
We do, too. We don’t think the VA is perfect, and we bet you’d agree. We’ve been working for 20 years to improve it — efficiency, expanded care, new resources to meet the needs of this generation of Veterans. Improvement is critical to VA’s mission.
What this administration is doing isn’t about efficiency or improving care. It is about turning the VA into the worst of private health insurance — deny care and maximize shareholder value. Trump and Elon have made that perfectly clear.
Here’s how:
**FIRST** they fired 2400 VA staff. These were probationary hires, many of them Veterans themselves. Fresh talent and internal transfers or promotions — the pipeline for future sustainment of the VA.
**THEN** Trump’s former lawyer and current counsellor, Alina Habba, said that the Veterans Trump fired are **“not fit to have a job at this moment.”** To every Veteran that lost their job: **“I really don’t feel sorry for them.”** They know what they’re doing — and they don’t care.
**NOW** we’ve got leaked reports from inside the VA that Trump wants to fire another 83,000 VA staff. That’s a reduction of nearly 20%. There isn’t a single element of the VA that would be spared by these cuts. If they go through with it, Veterans will die for lack of care.
And remember: They’re doing this — deriding the Veterans and staff who do the work, firing them, and impacting service — to privatize the VA for good. It is a betrayal. Full stop.
VoteVets has taken on the GOP and their efforts to destroy the VA for years. We’ve beaten them every time. But we’ve never taken on a challenge like this.
If we’re going to save the VA from Trump and Elon Musk, we’re going to need your help.

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, just over
40 days into his presidency, Donald Trump gave a joint address to Congress
last night to make his vision clear: theft, plain and simple.

Alongside Elon Musk and a Cabinet occupied by more billionaires than ever
before, they're hell-bent on stealing everything from working-class
Americans to line their own pockets. His vision for the U.S. is to sell
the last pieces of our democracy to his richest friends. It's called
kleptocracy.

Killing thousands of federal workers' jobs and defunding Medicaid, Social
Security, and food assistance to fund trillions in tax cuts for
billionaires and corporations. At home and abroad, his only vision is
selling out ordinary people to the highest bidder. That’s the only
expertise Elon Musk brings.

Their commitment to enriching themselves and their ultra-wealthy cronies
by any means necessary will cost millions of people their homes, health,
jobs, and food.

We’re already seeing children dying of starvation while aid rots in
warehouses, seniors rationing life-saving medication, and Palestinians
being expelled from the tiny areas of their homeland not already annexed
by Israel — just so Trump can build a Trump Hotel in Gaza and make himself
millions.

Their greed knows no bounds. As Republicans bow down to his Congressional
power grabs, corporate Democrats are asleep at the wheel. What we don't
need is a Party that believes the right response to Trump is to look back
fondly on the Reagan administration and Republican leadership during the

But I know that together, we can start changing the political tides and repair the damage to our country. = = Onward and forward – and let's build a better tomorrow! subject: Jim Jordan is stuck in the past - let’s end his political future
body:
alt [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
Here we go again.
Jim Jordan has one job: to fight for the people he represents.
Instead, he’s spending his time obsessing over Hunter Biden like it’s still 2020.
For Trump’s big speech to Congress, Jordan could have invited anyone—a struggling family about to lose Medicaid, a veteran facing cuts to VA services, a worker laid off because of Republican budget slashes.
Who did he invite instead?
Two guys who pushed a conspiracy theory that went nowhere—because digging into Biden’s finances is more important to him than fighting for everyday people.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-c2g-post-elec?refcode=20250305_jordans_guests_image [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-c2g-post-elec?refcode=20250305_jordans_guests_image]
If you’re as tired as I am of Jim Jordan living in the past, let’s upend his future—chip in today and help send him packing. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-c2g-post-elec?refcode=20250305_jordans_guests_link1]
Jordan and his Republican buddies love to claim they’re all about fiscal responsibility, but they just greenlit cuts that will rip healthcare away from millions.
Over 90 million Americans rely on Medicaid, but instead of fighting to protect them, Jim Jordan is laser-focused on political revenge.
Let’s be real—what exactly does dragging Hunter Biden’s name through the mud do for:
- Families worried about skyrocketing grocery prices?
- Seniors struggling to afford medications?
- Veterans losing access to critical healthcare?
Absolutely nothing. But that’s Jim Jordan’s whole thing—yelling about fake scandals while ignoring the real crises hurting everyday Americans.
Meanwhile, House Republicans are now banning in-person town halls because they’re afraid of their own constituents.
They don’t want to answer for the disaster they’re creating.
And Jim Jordan? He still won’t hold a real public forum.
I’m not afraid of facing voters. I actually want to hear from you.
If you’re sick of Jordan’s circus act while everyday Americans struggle, chip in today. Every dollar helps us expose his failures and take this fight straight to him. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-c2g-post-elec?refcode=20250305_jordans_guests_link2]
America deserves better than this clown show. Let’s make sure Jordan knows his time is UP!
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

Peter Willis, last night,
Trump showed why he is such an existential threat to our country. He
repeated OUTLANDISH lies about Social Security, celebrated ‘drill, baby,
drill,’ championed trillions in tax cuts for the rich, and put America’s
Oligarchy on full display.

In response, Bernie said something that he’s NEVER said before:

"My friends, we are no longer moving toward an oligarchy. We are living IN
an oligarchic society... President Trump has been creating what I would call
a parallel universe for his supporters – a set of ideas that either have
NO basis in reality or, in the great scheme of things, are nowhere near
the most important concerns of the American people."

[ Elon ]Elon Musk saluting at Trump's State of the Union

Most importantly, we cannot wait for the system to change itself. Nor can
we sit around waiting for Trump and his followers to suddenly wake up and
see that they’ve been duped. We need to fight back, and expose his lies in
an irrefutable way.

Peter Willis, we know it
may feel like opposition is hopeless. Republicans have a trifecta of
power, and the blitzkrieg of executive orders, trade wars, billionaire tax
breaks, and federal aid cuts can be overwhelming. But we have already
proven that Trump and his oligarchic agenda CAN be thwarted.

* He has flip-flopped on his disastrous tariffs against Canada and
Mexico, after mass-outrage from the public.
* Our pressure convinced his administration to roll back their freeze on
Medicaid, Medicare, and SNAP.
* The Supreme Court just voted to reverse Trump’s $2 billion in cuts to
foreign aid programs.

Trump and Musk aren’t evil masterminds or brilliant puppeteers. They’re
bullies. Loud, angry, deceitful brutes, trying to take a sledgehammer to
our government in order to enrich themselves and their billionaire
friends.

But that means they can be stopped. They will continue to make mistake
after mistake in pursuit of their agenda. And it’s up to all of us to keep
calling out their lies, and calling out the complicity from spineless
members of Congress — especially those in politically vulnerable
districts.

President Trump delivered a historic, record-breaking speech to Congress last night. The 100 minute, 9,900 word speech broke President Clinton's record from the 2000 State of the Union. Beyond the length, was the power, grace and impact of the speech. President Trump highlighted the accomplishments already made within the first 43 days of his administration. Among those include undoing the disastrous and tragic policies from the Biden administration. From Payton McNabb, who was left with a traumatic brain injury after a transgender-identifying man spiked a volleyball into her head to the family of Laken Riley, who was killed by an illegal immigrant while out for a jog. President Trump signed the Laken Riley Act immediately upon taking office and designated the brutal gang members and cartels as foreign terrorist. The president is forever tied to Corey Comperatore and his family as he honored the fallen firefighters memory. It was teary-eyed as Secret Service agent Sean Curry hugged 13 year old DJ Daniel, who is fighting brain cancer but dreams of becoming a police officer. President Trump proved he is a man of great empathy as the facade of the Democratic party's once claim to being the "party of the people" fades away as they sit their scowl-faced and smug the entire time. From securing the border, eliminating waste, fraud and abuse to perhaps peace in Ukraine, it turns out, all we needed was a new president.

Hi everyone. Senator Elissa Slotkin here.

Last night, I gave the official response to President Trump’s Joint Address. I hope you had a chance to watch.

Since I’m a stranger to most people who don’t follow politics, I introduced myself and just kept it straight with the people watching about the moment we are in right now.

We just went through another fraught election season. Americans made it clear that they want change. But there is a responsible way to make change, and a reckless way. And, we can make that change without forgetting who we are as a country, and as a democracy.

Because no matter where you live, most Americans share three core beliefs: That the middle class is the engine of our country. That strong national security protects us from harm. And that our democracy, no matter how messy, is unparalleled and worth fighting for.

We all know that our country is going through something right now. We’re not sure what the next day is going to hold, let alone the next decade.

But this isn’t the first time we’ve experienced this as a country. Every single time, we’ve gotten through those moments because of two things: Engaged citizens and principled leaders.

If you're with me in that fight, I have an ask of you:

Grab a cup of coffee (or water), take a breath, and let your shoulders down. Take another breath, maybe close your eyes for a moment. Just a moment, it's alright.
We're going to think big thoughts, and in order to do that, we need to be thinking clearly -- hydrated, calm, and well-oxygenated. Take another breath.
Consider that to effectively design new political and economic systems that truly serve human flourishing, we need to integrate the best of what human thought and civilization have to offer into a moral and philosophical framework that can guide the design of these new systems.
(Big thoughts. Another breath. Let's dive in.)
Human flourishing--both individual and collective--requires a framework that integrates ethical depth, social justice, economic sustainability, and personal fulfillment. No single tradition holds the complete answer, but by synthesizing the strongest elements of various philosophical and religious traditions, we can construct a holistic model that supports human well-being across all dimensions.
The best system would likely integrate the strongest aspects of multiple traditions--including Islamic philosophy, virtue ethics, cooperative economics, and modern systems thinking--while mitigating their respective weaknesses. Let's start with a comparative analysis of Islamic guidance - explored more fully in my last post - alongside six other influential frameworks, and then consider what an optimized synthesis might look like.
* * *
### Comparative Analysis of Frameworks for Human Flourishing
#### 1\. Islamic Philosophy (Tawhidic Ethics)
**Strengths:**
* **Holistic moral integration** : No separation between personal ethics and social justice.
* **Justice-centric economic framework** : Prohibition of exploitation (riba), wealth redistribution (zakat), and ethical trade.
* **Balance of individual and collective well-being** : Rights and duties are both emphasized.
* **Spiritual foundation for meaning** : Purpose is deeply connected to divine accountability and the interconnectedness of creation.

**Weaknesses:**
* **Historical rigidity in interpretation** : Some interpretations struggle to adapt to modern complexities.
* **Legalism over ethics** : Some traditions emphasize rules over moral intent.
* **Gender and hierarchy tensions:** While early Islam advanced gender rights, later interpretations sometimes reinforced inequities.

#### 2\. Aristotelian Virtue Ethics (Eudaimonia)
**Strengths** :
* Character-driven morality: Focuses on developing virtues such as courage, wisdom, and justice.
* Personal agency in ethics: Moral reasoning is emphasized over blind adherence to rules.
* Lifelong self-improvement: Encourages continuous growth toward the 'good life' (eudaimonia).

**Weaknesses:**
* **Lacks systemic social justice mechanisms:** More focused on individual virtue than structural transformation.
* **No divine accountability:** Can lead to subjective moral relativism without a shared ethical anchor.

#### 3\. Confucianism (Harmony and Reciprocity)
**Strengths:**
* **Strong social cohesion:** Emphasizes duty, respect, and harmony in relationships.
* **Education and self-cultivation** : Encourages lifelong learning as key to moral and social progress.
* **Hierarchical but reciprocal justice** : Leaders are expected to be virtuous and benevolent.

**Weaknesses:**
* **Rigid social roles:** Historically reinforced hierarchy and conformity.
* **Lack of systemic critique** : More about maintaining harmony than challenging unjust structures.

#### 4\. Enlightenment Liberalism (Individual Rights & Rational Ethics)
**Strengths:**
* **Strong protection of individual rights** : Life, liberty, and property are central.
* **Scientific and rational inquiry** : Encourages progress through reason and empirical evidence.
* **Secular governance** : Separates morality from religious authority, allowing pluralism.

**Weaknesses:**
* **Hyper-individualism:** Weakens communal responsibility and social bonds.
* **Exploitation within capitalism:** Prioritization of free markets can lead to inequality.
* **Moral relativism** : Without shared ethics, justice can become transactional.

#### 5\. Buddhist Ethics (Interdependence & Non-Attachment)
**Strengths** :
* **Focus on reducing suffering** : Moral actions are judged by their impact on well-being.
* **Deep understanding of the mind** : Meditation and self-awareness improve decision-making.
* **Minimalist economics** : Challenges consumerism and greed as sources of suffering.

**Weaknesses:**
* **Detachment can lead to passivity:** May discourage systemic activism.
* **No strong legal or economic framework** : Does not offer clear governance principles.

#### 6\. Indigenous & Regenerative Systems Thinking
**Strengths** :
* **Ecological sustainability** : Recognizes interdependence of human and non-human life.
* **Consensus-based decision-making** : Promotes deep democracy and communal wisdom.
* **Resilience-focused** : Seeks long-term well-being over short-term gain.

**Weaknesses** :
* **Local applicability over universality** : Works best in community-based governance, but struggles at scale.
* **Oral traditions can lack structural rigor** : Often lacks written legal and economic codification.

#### **7\. Stoicism (Resilience & Inner Discipline)**
**Strengths:**
* **Mastery of self:** Emphasizes emotional resilience, rational thought, and personal discipline.
* **Ethical consistency** : Encourages individuals to act with integrity, regardless of external circumstances.
* **Practical philosophy** : Provides a clear guide for navigating hardship and maintaining inner peace in a chaotic world.

**Weaknesses:**
* **Limited systemic vision** : Focuses more on personal ethics and resilience than societal structures.
* **Potential for emotional suppression** : Can encourage detachment rather than fostering emotional health.
* **Less emphasis on communal responsibility:** Primarily an individual-oriented philosophy, though it encourages duty and service.

* * *
The strengths and weaknesses of these diverse traditions reveal an important truth: **no single framework is sufficient on its own**. Each provides valuable insights, yet also has blind spots or limitations. Islamic ethics offer a deep commitment to justice and community, but can struggle with modern adaptability. Aristotelian virtue ethics cultivate strong individual character, yet lack systemic solutions for economic and social inequalities. Indigenous wisdom prioritizes sustainability and consensus, but often functions best on a smaller scale. Stoicism provides unmatched personal resilience but has limited mechanisms for large-scale social transformation. The same pattern holds across all these traditions--each has something powerful to contribute, but none provides the complete answer in isolation.
This is why an integrative approach is essential. By consciously drawing on the best elements of each tradition--balancing moral integrity with social flexibility, individual growth with collective justice, and material progress with spiritual wisdom--we can build a framework that supports true human flourishing. The goal is not to erase differences but to weave a more comprehensive, resilient model that can address the challenges of our time.
* * *
### **Core Principles of an Integrated Model**
#### **1\. Transcendent Ethical Anchoring (Islamic Tawhid, Stoicism & Virtue Ethics)**
* A flourishing society requires a shared moral foundation rooted in justice, mercy, and wisdom.
* Ethical principles should be universal yet adaptable to different cultural contexts.
* The concept of _Tawhid_ (oneness and interconnectedness) provides a unifying moral compass beyond individual or tribal interests.
* Stoic principles of rationality, self-discipline, and virtue reinforce moral consistency in all circumstances.

#### **2\. Self-Cultivation & Agency (Aristotle, Confucianism, Buddhism, Stoicism)**
* Virtue development is a lifelong process; individuals must cultivate integrity, wisdom, and resilience.
* Education is not merely for economic advancement but for moral and personal growth.
* Mindfulness and self-awareness enhance ethical decision-making and social harmony.
* Stoicism teaches the mastery of self and control over reactions, complementing the importance of self-awareness and intentionality.

#### **3\. Social and Economic Justice** _(Islamic Economics & Indigenous Models)_
* Wealth and resources should be distributed ethically, ensuring the well-being of all members of society.
* Systems like _zakat_ (obligatory charity), cooperative ownership, and regenerative economics create sustainable prosperity.
* Economic structures should prevent exploitation and ensure financial stability for all.

#### **4\. Ecological and Systemic Sustainability** _(Regenerative Indigenous Thinking)_
* Societies must operate within ecological limits, prioritizing sustainability over short-term profit.
* Human well-being is interconnected with planetary health.
* Decision-making should consider long-term environmental and social consequences.

#### **5\. Scientific and Rational Inquiry** _(Enlightenment Liberalism & Buddhist Inquiry)_
* Policies and governance should be based on evidence, reason, and ethical considerations.
* Scientific advancements should be integrated with spiritual and ethical wisdom.
* Open dialogue and critical thinking must be encouraged within societies.

#### **6\. Governance That Merges Justice & Flexibility (Islamic Shura, Confucianism, Modern Democracy, Stoicism)**
* Decision-making should balance wisdom, collective input, and ethical leadership.
* Institutions must be adaptable while maintaining moral coherence.
* Governance should incorporate consultation (_shura_), merit-based leadership, and civic engagement.
* Stoicism's emphasis on duty, rationality, and public service aligns with ethical governance principles, promoting leaders who act with integrity and reason.

* * *
### **Building a Future of Flourishing**
Instead of choosing one framework over others, we must weave together complementary strengths to create a system that fosters personal fulfillment, communal well-being, and planetary sustainability. Our model should integrate:
* **Islamic Tawhid (moral unity & justice)**
* **Aristotelian virtue development**
* **Confucian social harmony**
* **Liberal democratic institutions**
* **Indigenous sustainability**
* **Buddhist mindfulness & self-mastery**
* **Stoic resilience & self-discipline**
* **Regenerative economic models**

This synthesis allows for human flourishing at all levels--personal, communal, economic, and planetary--while avoiding the pitfalls of rigidity, exploitation, and imbalance. By consciously designing our social, economic, and political systems around these principles, we can cultivate a future that is not only just and prosperous but also deeply fulfilling for all.
I hope you're - still - calm, hydrated, and well-oxygenated. Whatever our piece of the work may be, the world needs us at our best.
Whatever these ideas bring up for you, I want to leave you with one thought - that most of the time, **what holds us back is not the lack of a calling, but a fear of answering the call.**
If something in this resonates with you, I encourage you to sit with it awhile. See what's calling... and consider, just consider, answering.
Peace be with you all. See you next time.
\- Melissa

Buddhist Ethics (Interdependence & Non-Attachment) Strengths : Focus on reducing suffering : Moral actions are judged by their impact on well-being. Deep understanding of the mind : Meditation and self-awareness improve decision-making. Minimalist economics : Challenges consumerism and greed as sources of suffering. Weaknesses: Detachment can lead to passivity: May discourage systemic activism. No strong legal or economic framework : Does not offer clear governance principles. 6\. Indigenous & Regenerative Systems Thinking Strengths : Ecological sustainability : Recognizes interdependence of human and non-human life. Consensus-based decision-making : Promotes deep democracy and communal wisdom. Resilience-focused : Seeks long-term well-being over short-term gain. Weaknesses : Local applicability over universality : Works best in community-based governance, but struggles at scale. Oral traditions can lack structural rigor : Often lacks written legal and economic codification. 7\. Stoicism (Resilience & Inner Discipline) Strengths: Mastery of self: Emphasizes emotional resilience, rational thought, and personal discipline. Ethical consistency : Encourages individuals to act with integrity, regardless of external circumstances. Practical philosophy : Provides a clear guide for navigating hardship and maintaining inner peace in a chaotic world. Weaknesses: Limited systemic vision : Focuses more on personal ethics and resilience than societal structures. Potential for emotional suppression : Can encourage detachment rather than fostering emotional health. Less emphasis on communal responsibility: Primarily an individual-oriented philosophy, though it encourages duty and service. The strengths and weaknesses of these diverse traditions reveal an important truth: no single framework is sufficient on its own. Each provides valuable insights, yet also has blind spots or limitations. Islamic ethics offer a deep commitment to justice and community, but can struggle with modern adaptability. Aristotelian virtue ethics cultivate strong individual character, yet lack systemic solutions for economic and social inequalities. Indigenous wisdom prioritizes sustainability and consensus, but often functions best on a smaller scale. Stoicism provides unmatched personal resilience but has limited mechanisms for large-scale social transformation. The same pattern holds across all these traditions--each has something powerful to contribute, but none provides the complete answer in isolation. This is why an integrative approach is essential. By consciously drawing on the best elements of each tradition--balancing moral integrity with social flexibility, individual growth with collective justice, and material progress with spiritual wisdom--we can build a framework that supports true human flourishing. The goal is not to erase differences but to weave a more comprehensive, resilient model that can address the challenges of our time. Core Principles of an Integrated Model 1\. Transcendent Ethical Anchoring (Islamic Tawhid, Stoicism & Virtue Ethics) A flourishing society requires a shared moral foundation rooted in justice, mercy, and wisdom. Ethical principles should be universal yet adaptable to different cultural contexts. The concept of Tawhid (oneness and interconnectedness) provides a unifying moral compass beyond individual or tribal interests. Stoic principles of rationality, self-discipline, and virtue reinforce moral consistency in all circumstances. 2\. Self-Cultivation & Agency (Aristotle, Confucianism, Buddhism, Stoicism) Virtue development is a lifelong process; individuals must cultivate integrity, wisdom, and resilience. Education is not merely for economic advancement but for moral and personal growth. Mindfulness and self-awareness enhance ethical decision-making and social harmony. Stoicism teaches the mastery of self and control over reactions, complementing the importance of self-awareness and intentionality. 3\. Social and Economic Justice (Islamic Economics & Indigenous Models) Wealth and resources should be distributed ethically, ensuring the well-being of all members of society. Systems like zakat (obligatory charity), cooperative ownership, and regenerative economics create sustainable prosperity. Economic structures should prevent exploitation and ensure financial stability for all. 4\. Ecological and Systemic Sustainability (Regenerative Indigenous Thinking) Societies must operate within ecological limits, prioritizing sustainability over short-term profit. Human well-being is interconnected with planetary health. Decision-making should consider long-term environmental and social consequences. 5\. Scientific and Rational Inquiry (Enlightenment Liberalism & Buddhist Inquiry) Policies and governance should be based on evidence, reason, and ethical considerations. Scientific advancements should be integrated with spiritual and ethical wisdom. Open dialogue and critical thinking must be encouraged within societies. 6\. Governance That Merges Justice & Flexibility (Islamic Shura, Confucianism, Modern Democracy, Stoicism) Decision-making should balance wisdom, collective input, and ethical leadership. Institutions must be adaptable while maintaining moral coherence. Governance should incorporate consultation (shura), merit-based leadership, and civic engagement. Stoicism's emphasis on duty, rationality, and public service aligns with ethical governance principles, promoting leaders who act with integrity and reason. Building a Future of Flourishing Instead of choosing one framework over others, we must weave together complementary strengths to create a system that fosters personal fulfillment, communal well-being, and planetary sustainability. Our model should integrate: Islamic Tawhid (moral unity & justice) Aristotelian virtue development Confucian social harmony Liberal democratic institutions Indigenous sustainability Buddhist mindfulness & self-mastery Stoic resilience & self-discipline Regenerative economic models This synthesis allows for human flourishing at all levels--personal, communal, economic, and planetary--while avoiding the pitfalls of rigidity, exploitation, and imbalance. By consciously designing our social, economic, and political systems around these principles, we can cultivate a future that is not only just and prosperous but also deeply fulfilling for all. I hope you're - still - calm, hydrated, and well-oxygenated. Whatever our piece of the work may be, the world needs us at our best. Whatever these ideas bring up for you, I want to leave you with one thought - that most of the time, what holds us back is not the lack of a calling, but a fear of answering the call. If something in this resonates with you, I encourage you to sit with it awhile. See what's calling... and consider, just consider, answering. Peace be with you all. clean_body: Give now to help us continue the fight against this administration's extremist policies! | | | Did you watch Donald Trump's address last night, friend? If you did, then you'll know, too, that there were no surprises. Trump did what he always does — create more division and chaos in our country. He spread misinformation, exaggerations and lies to claim victories over his policies in a very partisan speech to Congress. But while he boasted about his first few weeks in office, the truth is this: His executive orders have done nothing more than harm the average hardworking American. = | | = Trump MUST be held accountable for his actions: Attacking the Department of Education , illegally firing countless federal workers , threatening the future of Medicaid and so much more. And what's worse is that he's pushing these cuts so that the ultrawealthy can profit at the expense of hardworking Americans. I'm working every day to fight against this extremism and come to real, bipartisan solutions that help American families — in New York and across the country. I've secured wins for us already, including protecting the World Trade Center Health Program, and I'm determined to secure even more in the next few years. But I can't do it alone, friend. = | | = Thank you for standing with me in this fight to defend our democracy. Kirsten | * | = A note from Kirsten: Friend, I am truly honored to have won reelection, and I promise to continue the critical work toward bipartisan solutions for New Yorkers as we enter this new term. While we had many victories in New York this election season, our fight to retake control of the Senate is far from over. = Thank you, Kirsten Gillibrand

Hello,
I’m Gay Valimont, FL-1 candidate, and for years I have witnessed the Florida I know and love become a battleground for the middle class, and a playground for millionaires like Trump.
I’m running to bring compassionate, accountable leadership to Washington. I am committed to addressing the critical issues that impact our community, and I need your help to make this vision a reality.
We have less than a month to gather the support we need to beat the GOP, and secure Congress. Help me!!

Here’s what I plan to do as your representative:
📣 Champion Common-Sense Gun Control: We must act to reduce gun violence while protecting the rights of responsible gun owners. I will advocate for universal background checks, banning assault weapons, and closing loopholes that make it too easy for dangerous individuals to acquire firearms.
📣 Support Farmers and Agriculture: Our farmers work tirelessly to feed this state, and I will fight for policies that ensure they have the tools, resources, and support to thrive.
📣 Expand Healthcare Access: Everyone deserves affordable healthcare. I will work to lower healthcare costs, protect Medicaid, and ensure that no one is left behind when it comes to accessing care.
📣 Hold Government Accountable: It’s time for leaders who put the people’s needs first. I will prioritize transparency and work to ensure that decisions are made with integrity and compassion.
📣 Protect Our Environment: As an advocate for sustainable policies, I am dedicated to preserving Florida’s natural beauty and ensuring that we take meaningful steps to protect our environment for future generations.

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: I see right through Trump
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
This is all an intentional distraction tactic. They know exactly what they’re doing.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2496%2E4032634%2E6nyxAV)
---
Last night Donald Trump spent time talking about renaming the Gulf of Mexico to the “Gulf of America.” He spent time bragging about making English the official language of the United States. He promoted a $5 million dollar “gold card” offering, inviting the wealthy to buy access to US citizenship. He spent time targeting and politicizing a small group of transgender student athletes as a fear-mongering tactic. He spent time bragging about DOGE firing thousands of federal workers that actually make the government more efficient and listing uncorroborated, wild claims about all of the “government waste” that Elon Musk has identified. That “waste” they cut out was actually cancer research, veterans programs, and support for farmers. And he spent time suggesting that the alleged days of rule by unelected bureaucrats are over — right after praising unelected bureaucrat Elon Musk taking a literal chainsaw to rule over our government. But he did not spend any time laying out any actual plans to deliver the change that working people are actually crying out for: lower costs. It’s because he is doing nothing to actually ease the economic pains that people are feeling. In fact, what he’s doing will inflict even more pain. And he’s taking advantage of the pain that people are feeling to distort the truth. **Last night had a lot of ugliness, crazy and shocking stories, and contradictions. Stuff that would make any fact-checker’s head explode. This is all an intentional distraction tactic. They know exactly what they’re doing.** Because Donald Trump and the Republican party have a long-game plan to cut taxes for billionaires and make everyone else pay for it. The best way to slip through an unpopular plan like that is to stir us up and distract us by saying a bunch of absurd things — _Gold cards! Gulf of America! Trans kids and immigrant families are out to get you!_ — and hope that nobody will actually see what’s happening. Donald Trump is handing our country to a handful of billionaires. I see it. Others see it. I hope you see it too. [**We’re ready to fight back on this. I’m not going to vote to give tax breaks to billionaires. I’m going to do everything I possibly can to make their plan clear to Congress and to the public so we can build the movement we need to stop them. If you’re able, please pitch in $28 or anything you can to help power this fight.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2934?amount=28&t=8&akid=2496%2E4032634%2E6nyxAV)

name: AOC
subject: It's not just about what Trump is saying
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
So, the State of the Union happened last night. Trump said a lot of random things about studies, and waste, and all this other stuff.
**He did _not_ talk about Medicaid. Not once.**
It's not just about what Trump is saying — it's about the big obvious things that he is _ignoring_.
If he was confident about his attacks on Medicaid, he would have said something, wouldn't he? He's confident about his attacks on immigrants. He's confident about his attacks on federal workers. He's confident about all _those_ things.
**Why won't he and Republicans own up to their attacks on Medicaid?**
This week, they told every Republican in the House of Representatives to stop doing town halls. **Why?**
Because they're getting too much heat over Medicaid.
What they are trying to cut is to the tune of _$880 billion_. I sit on the committee that Medicaid goes through — and the math ain't mathin’.
Republicans’ amount of so-called ‘waste’ that they have identified — if you believe absolutely everything in their wildest fantasies — is only $50 billion.
**So where's the other $830 billion coming from?**
It's coming from grandma.
It's coming from your prescriptions.
It's coming from your insulin. It's coming from your kids' co-pay.
**They are setting up to rob you**. That was the moral of the story of this State of the Union last night.
Their number one priority is to rob Medicaid, Medicare, Social Security, and all of our public systems in order to pay for tax cuts for billionaires.
But we do not have to comply with illegal activity — **even if that illegal activity is coming from the President of the United States**.

subject: History is watching. What will you do?

body:
Let’s fight like hell.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/103320463/531798173/1328794144?refcode=ea.1eb6a33f-18fa-ef11-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ms=ea.1eb6a33f-18fa-ef11-90cd-0022482a9fb7&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFlYjZhMzNmLTE4ZmEtZWYxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=GKbkUFWHoxdwcOpRUcUc0qdAJVBR-nwrFQsfH-_z0t4=&emci=22a2da92-02fa-ef11-90cd-0022482a9fb7&emdi=1eb6a33f-18fa-ef11-90cd-0022482a9fb7&ceid=4823105)
---
Last night, we saw it with our own eyes. The president took the stage to unleash a vision for America that we cannot allow to become reality. He called it "strength." I call it what it is: cruelty. A full-scale assault on everything we hold dear. Trump vowed to hand over our public lands to Big Oil, chanting "drill, baby, drill" like he was leading a fossil fuel pep rally. He doubled down on his racist, fearmongering attacks on migrants and the LGBTQ community. He took aim at Social Security and bragged about his massive tax cuts for the ultra-wealthy — because in Trump’s America, billionaires get handouts while working families get scraps. And when people pushed back, he smirked. Dared them to stop him. But someone did. Representative Al Green from Texas stood up and called Trump out for what he is: illegitimate. Dangerous. A man with no mandate to gut Medicaid or sell out our democracy to the highest bidder. And for that, he was escorted out of the chamber by the Sergeant at Arms — the first time in recent history a member was expelled from a joint address to Congress. Republicans laughed. They mocked him as they took him away. But that disruption? That’s the energy we need from every single Democrat — and every Republican, for that matter. We can’t let this become the new normal. We cannot be silent while the Orange Man lays the groundwork to dismantle our democracy. We have to fight back by organizing and building power from the ground up. The strongest firewall against Trump’s reckless agenda starts in our own communities. We have to take back city councils, school boards, and state legislatures. He called it "strength." I call it what it is: cruelty. A full-scale assault on everything we hold dear. Trump vowed to hand over our public lands to Big Oil, chanting "drill, baby, drill" like he was leading a fossil fuel pep rally. He doubled down on his racist, fearmongering attacks on migrants and the LGBTQ community. He took aim at Social Security and bragged about his massive tax cuts for the ultra-wealthy — because in Trump’s America, billionaires get handouts while working families get scraps. And when people pushed back, he smirked. Dared them to stop him. But someone did. Representative Al Green from Texas stood up and called Trump out for what he is: illegitimate. Dangerous. A man with no mandate to gut Medicaid or sell out our democracy to the highest bidder. And for that, he was escorted out of the chamber by the Sergeant at Arms — the first time in recent history a member was expelled from a joint address to Congress. Republicans laughed. They mocked him as they took him away. But that disruption? That’s the energy we need from every single Democrat — and every Republican, for that matter. We can’t let this become the new normal. Friend, More and more people across the country are rising up and saying: Enough is enough. Last night, while addressing a joint session of Congress, the president explicitly thanked Elon Musk, the unelected billionaire who’s stealing from our communities for his personal profit. This week I rallied outside the Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) with HUD workers, housing advocates, and my Congressional colleagues to demand that these firings stop. Cuts to housing will impact many vulnerable communities that are already facing a housing crisis, including veterans, Black and brown communities, children living with disabilities, LGBTQ+ people, rural communities, and more. My why is the hard working people I grew up with in Mon Valley — factory workers, teachers, and who are the lifeblood of our state. My why is my mom and dad — a hairdresser and a union bus driver I watched juggle bills, putting food on the table, and raising a family. My why is my wife Blayre and my daughter Harper who both deserve access to reproductive healthcare and bodily autonomy. My why is the people of Pennsylvania. Knowing my why is what gets me up in the morning and what motivates me to fight for the people of Pennsylvania every day. Maybe your why is like mine.
