Peter, Last night, Donald Trump spread more harmful lies during his joint address to Congress. I wasn’t in attendance. Instead, I joined Senators Chris Murphy, Brian Schatz, and Ed Markey — along with other elected leaders, political commentators, and MoveOn, an organization focused on mobilizing for political progress — to provide live fact-checking for each of Trump’s lies. So many Americans are feeling overwhelmed, anxious, and concerned about making ends meet and the survival of our democracy itself. My colleagues and I used last night’s address to ground Trump’s rambling speech in reality, and get clear on how we got here and where we’re going. Before this second Trump presidency, we were already facing an epidemic of loneliness and disconnection. This laid the groundwork for the MAGA movement’s rage-centered ideology to take hold. **The antidote to this is doing everything we can to reconnect.** That means sparking conversations with our neighbors and working with organizations on the ground doing good work to strengthen our communities. This kind of collaboration and civic engagement is alive and well in Vermont, where yesterday we celebrated Town Meeting Day, a day where every town meets and the community votes on the town's business. A true form of direct democracy. To say things are hard right now would be an understatement. But we can’t back down at such a critical crossroads in our history. We have to care for ourselves and stay in connection with others to ensure we can show up to fight another day tomorrow. Because we are the changemakers. We are the ones we’ve been waiting for. Peter, my last piece of advice to you is this: Do what you can, when you can. You can’t do it all. Change takes time. Stay in this fight, and I promise you we will see progress — no matter what that little voice in the back of your head might say. body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=39487%2E3422442%2E9wBlhD)
Derek,
This week, we’re learning that Donald Trump and Elon Musk have laid off around 1,000 National Park Service employees—around 5% of the agency’s workforce.
Our parks have already been struggling to accommodate the hundreds of millions of visitors each year. Trump’s attack on federal workers moves us in the exact wrong direction.
Yes, there will be longer lines, more trash, and dirtier bathrooms. But, it’s also going to be a lot more dangerous than that.
Less trail maintenance means that they will be less safe for visitors. Fewer staffers means fewer small fires getting put out, increasing the risk that they grow into big blazes.
In Congress, I served on the committee with jurisdiction over our public lands. One of my priorities was listening to and learning from the amazing park staff, who chose those careers because they believe in safeguarding our national treasures for all to enjoy.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20250305-2?refcode=em20250305-39487&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39487_3422442_9wBlhD&akid=39487%2E3422442%2E9wBlhD)
Trump’s callous dismantling of the federal workforce is a slap in the face to those dedicated public servants. He is putting visitors’ lives at risk. He is threatening communities across this country, whose local economies rely on tourism and conservation.
**[We need to hold the Trump Administration accountable for making us all less safe—from national parks, to air traffic control, to cybersecurity. Will you chip in to my PAC, Truth to Power, so that we have the resources to get this message to voters and so they don’t forget when they head to the ballot box in 2026?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20250305-2?refcode=em20250305-39487&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39487_3422442_9wBlhD&akid=39487%2E3422442%2E9wBlhD)**
Thanks for all you do,
Katie

Truth to Power supports candidates who will stand up to Donald Trump, fight to lower costs, and protect the environment. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/truth-to-power-1?refcode=em20250305-39487&amounts=&t=2&refcode2=39487_3422442_9wBlhD&akid=39487%2E3422442%2E9wBlhD)**
